recipes.name: Tofu and Broccoli Stir-fry with Rice
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 tbsp maple syrup or agave syrup
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then cut it into bite-sized cubes. Cut the broccoli into small florets. Cook the rice according to package directions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and maple syrup (or agave syrup) to create a sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes and cook until golden brown and slightly crispy on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the tofu. Stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the tofu and broccoli. Stir well to coat everything evenly and cook for another 1-2 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the tofu and broccoli stir-fry immediately over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Sticky Honey-Glazed Tofu with Rice
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, pressed and cut into cubes
1 tbsp maple syrup or agave syrup
instructions: Press the tofu to remove as much water as possible, then cut it into bite-sized cubes. Cook the rice according to package directions.
In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, maple syrup (or agave syrup), and water. Stir until well mixed.
Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes in a single layer and cook until golden brown and crispy on all sides, about 6-8 minutes.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the tofu in the skillet. Cook, stirring gently, for about 2-3 minutes, until the sauce thickens and coats the tofu.
Serve the sticky glazed tofu immediately over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Simple Savory Tofu Rice Bowl
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then cut it into bite-sized cubes. Cook the rice according to package directions.
Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes and cook until they are golden brown and slightly crispy on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Pour the soy sauce over the tofu in the skillet. Stir gently to coat the tofu and cook for another 1-2 minutes until the soy sauce is absorbed and slightly caramelized.
Serve the savory tofu over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Spinach and Chickpea Sauté
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for another minute until fragrant. Be careful not to burn the garlic.
Stir in the drained and rinsed chickpeas. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chickpeas are heated through.
Add the fresh spinach to the pan, a handful at a time if needed. Stir gently until the spinach wilts down, which should only take a few minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking. Serve warm as a side dish or a light meal.

recipes.name: Quick Chickpea and Spinach Curry
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook until it becomes soft and see-through, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute until you can smell its aroma. Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and paprika, stirring for another 30 seconds to toast the spices.
Pour in the vegetable broth (or water) and add the rinsed chickpeas. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it cook for 10-15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Add the fresh spinach to the pot. Stir gently until the spinach wilts, which will only take a few minutes.
Taste the curry and season with salt and pepper as needed. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Garlicky Sautéed Spinach and Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-60 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to let it burn.
Add the drained and rinsed chickpeas to the skillet. Stir them around for about 3-5 minutes to heat them through and lightly coat them in the garlic oil.
Add the fresh spinach to the skillet. It might seem like a lot, but it will cook down quickly. Stir gently until the spinach wilts completely, which should take about 2-4 minutes.
Season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper to your taste. Stir one last time to combine everything.
Serve immediately as a healthy and satisfying side dish or a light main course.

recipes.name: Simple Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water according to the package directions until it is al dente, which means it's cooked through but still has a slight bite.

While the pasta is cooking, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften and break down a bit.

Once the pasta is cooked, drain it, reserving about half a cup of the starchy cooking water. Add the drained pasta directly to the skillet with the tomatoes. Stir in the fresh basil, and add a splash of the reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too dry.
Season the pasta with salt and pepper to your liking. Toss everything together gently to coat the pasta evenly with the tomato sauce and basil. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Tomato and Basil Vegetable Medley
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped tomato and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it softens and starts to release its juices.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil, and cook for another minute until it becomes fragrant. Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.

You can serve this as a light side dish. If you have other vegetables like zucchini or bell peppers, you could add them to the skillet with the tomatoes and cook until tender-crisp for a more substantial dish.

recipes.name: Simple Tomato Salad with Basil
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the diced tomatoes and chopped fresh basil.
Drizzle the olive oil over the tomatoes and basil. Season with salt and pepper to your preference.
Gently toss all the ingredients together to coat the tomatoes evenly with the oil and seasonings. Let it sit for a few minutes for the flavors to meld before serving.

recipes.name: Spiced Potato and Bell Pepper Hash
ingredients: 1/4 tsp paprika (optional, for color and mild flavor)
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the cooking oil over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for about 3-4 minutes until it starts to soften and become a little see-through.
Add the cubed potatoes and chopped bell pepper to the skillet. Stir everything together and cook for about 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and nicely browned.
Season the hash with salt, black pepper, and paprika if you are using it. Stir well to combine all the flavors and cook for another 2-3 minutes until everything is heated through. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Simple Potato and Bell Pepper Skillet
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until it is soft and slightly golden, about 5-7 minutes.

Add the diced potatoes and bell pepper to the skillet. Stir to coat them with the oil. Cover the skillet and cook for about 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are fork-tender and slightly browned.
Season the mixture generously with salt and black pepper. Stir well and cook for another 2-3 minutes to let the flavors meld. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Vegan Vegetable Patties
instructions: In a bowl, combine the mashed potato, finely chopped bell pepper, and finely chopped onion. Add the salt and black pepper, and mix everything together well.
Sprinkle the cornstarch over the mixture and mix again until it holds together. Shape the mixture into small, flat patties, about the size of your palm.

Heat the cooking oil in a skillet over medium heat. Carefully place the patties in the hot skillet and cook for about 5-7 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and heated through. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Creamy Coconut Lentil Curry
instructions: Rinse the lentils well under cold water. Dice the onion and carrot into small pieces.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced carrots and curry powder to the pot. Stir and cook for another 2 minutes until the spices are fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and water. Add the rinsed lentils and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir well and serve hot.

recipes.name: Spiced Lentils with Coconut and Carrot
instructions: Start by rinsing your lentils thoroughly under cold running water. Finely chop the onion and slice the carrot into thin rounds.
In a medium-sized pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it becomes soft and see-through, which should take about 5 minutes.
Stir in the sliced carrots and the curry powder. Cook for another minute, stirring constantly, until the curry powder smells aromatic.
Pour in the coconut milk and the water. Add the rinsed lentils to the pot and bring everything to a gentle boil.

Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the pot with a lid, and let it simmer for about 20 to 25 minutes. Check occasionally to ensure the lentils are tender and the liquid has thickened into a nice sauce.
Taste the mixture and add salt and pepper as needed. Stir well to combine the flavors and serve this hearty dish warm.

recipes.name: Quick Carrot and Onion Sauté with Lentils
instructions: Cook the lentils according to package directions until tender, then set aside. While the lentils cook, thinly slice the onion and julienne the carrots.
Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to soften and turn golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.

Add the julienned carrots and curry powder to the skillet. Stir well to coat everything in the spice and cook for another 3-5 minutes until the carrots are slightly tender but still have a little bite.
Pour in the water to create a little steam, which will help the carrots cook through. Cover the skillet and let it cook for about 5 minutes.
Season the carrot and onion mixture with salt and pepper to your taste. Stir everything together.
Serve the sautéed carrots and onions alongside the cooked lentils as a complete meal.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Onion Rice Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cups water (or vegetable broth if available)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is soft and translucent, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the uncooked rice to the saucepan and stir for about 1 minute until the grains are lightly coated in oil. Pour in the water (or vegetable broth), add salt and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan tightly, and let it simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice with a fork, stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Quick Mushroom and Onion Sauté with Parmesan
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and diced onion to the hot skillet. Season with salt and black pepper.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 7-10 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and have released their liquid, and the onions are softened.
Remove the skillet from the heat and sprinkle the grated Parmesan cheese over the top. Stir gently to combine and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Savory Onion and Mushroom Rice
ingredients: 2 cups water (or vegetable broth if available)
1 medium sized onion, cut into thin strips
Optional: a pinch of ground cardamom or other favorite spice
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced onion and cook, stirring often, until it is deeply golden brown and caramelized, about 10-15 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan with the onions and cook for another 5 minutes until they are softened.
Stir in the uncooked rice and toast it for about 2 minutes until the grains change color slightly.

Pour in the water (or vegetable broth), add salt, pepper, and any optional spices. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Let the rice stand, covered, off the heat for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork and serving.

recipes.name: Cheesy Tomato Toast
instructions: Toast the bread slices until they are golden brown and slightly crisp.
Place the cheese slices on top of the warm toast and let it melt for a minute or two. You can also pop them under a broiler briefly if you like your cheese extra bubbly.
Top the melted cheese with fresh tomato slices and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Smoky Tomato and Cheese Melts
instructions: Lightly toast the bread slices until they are golden. You can do this in a toaster, under the broiler, or in a dry pan.
Arrange the sliced tomatoes over the toasted bread.
Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the tomatoes. Dust lightly with smoked paprika for a smoky aroma and flavor.
Place the bread slices back under a broiler or in a hot oven (around 200°C/400°F) for 3-5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Watch carefully to prevent burning.
Drizzle with a little olive oil before serving.

recipes.name: Quick Tomato and Cheese Flatbread
instructions: Preheat your oven or toaster oven to 200°C (400°F).
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet. Spread a thin layer of crushed tomatoes over each slice.
Top the tomatoes with the cheese. If you have any dried herbs like oregano or basil, sprinkle them on now.
Bake for about 10-15 minutes, or until the bread is crisp around the edges and the cheese is fully melted and golden.
Drizzle with a little olive oil before serving.

recipes.name: Garlicky Cabbage Noodles
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions until they are tender. While the noodles are cooking, heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.

Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for about 30 seconds until you can smell its fragrance, being careful not to let it burn. Add the shredded cabbage and stir-fry for about 3-4 minutes until it becomes a little tender but still has a slight crunch.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the pan with the cabbage and garlic. Toss everything together well to combine.
Season the noodles and cabbage with salt and lime juice, then stir well to distribute the flavors evenly. Cook for another minute to ensure everything is heated through.

recipes.name: Simple Egg and Cabbage Stir-fry
instructions: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with half of the salt and set aside. Heat the cooking oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the shredded cabbage and the remaining salt, then stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes until the cabbage is tender-crisp.
Push the cabbage to one side of the pan. Pour the beaten eggs into the empty side of the pan and scramble them until they are just cooked through.
Break up the scrambled eggs and toss them with the cabbage. Stir in the lime juice and cook for another minute to combine all the flavors.

recipes.name: Garlic Egg and Cabbage Scramble
instructions: Whisk the eggs together in a bowl with the salt and lime juice. Heat the cooking oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells nice. Add the shredded cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 3-4 minutes until it starts to soften.
Pour the whisked eggs over the cabbage and garlic in the skillet. Let the eggs cook undisturbed for about 1 minute until the edges begin to set.
Gently stir and fold the eggs as they cook, just like making scrambled eggs, until they are cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Corn Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Warm the black beans and corn in a small saucepan over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until heated through. You can add a pinch of salt and pepper if you like.
Lay one tortilla flat. Sprinkle half of the cheese over one half of the tortilla. Top the cheese with half of the black bean and corn mixture. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the beans and corn.
Fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling, creating a half-moon shape. Repeat with the second tortilla and the remaining filling.
Heat the oil in a large skillet or on a griddle over medium heat. Carefully place the folded quesadillas in the skillet.
Cook for about 4-5 minutes per side, until the tortillas are golden brown and crispy, and the cheese is melted and gooey. You might need to press down gently with a spatula.
Let the quesadillas cool slightly before cutting them into wedges. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Black Bean and Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (8¾ oz) whole kernel corn, drained
Juice of 1/2 lime (optional, if you have it)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rinsed black beans and drained corn. Stir gently to mix them together.
Add the diced avocado to the bowl. If you have a lime, squeeze its juice over the ingredients. This adds a nice fresh flavor and helps keep the avocado from turning brown.
Season the salad with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir everything together carefully so you don't mash the avocado too much.
You can serve this salad right away, or let it chill in the refrigerator for a bit for a cooler, more refreshing taste.

recipes.name: Cheesy Corn and Black Bean Tortilla Bites
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly brush or spray a baking sheet with oil.
Cut the tortillas into wedges or squares, similar to how you would cut a pizza. Arrange them in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
In a bowl, mix the black beans and corn. Spoon a small amount of this mixture onto each tortilla piece.
Top the bean and corn mixture with a sprinkle of cheese. You want enough to cover it but not so much that it all slides off.
Bake for about 8-10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly, and the tortilla edges are lightly golden and crisp. Keep an eye on them so they don't burn.
Carefully remove the baking sheet from the oven. Let the bites cool for a minute or two before serving.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Ginger Rice
ingredients: 200 g chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tbsp cooking oil (like vegetable or canola)
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. While the rice is cooking, prepare your stir-fry ingredients.
In a small bowl, mix the tamari and grated ginger to create a simple sauce. Set aside.
Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook until they are browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the chicken. Stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes, until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green.
Pour the tamari-ginger sauce over the chicken and broccoli. Stir everything together to coat evenly and cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve the stir-fry immediately over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Simple Ginger-Infused Steamed Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Drain the rice well in a sieve.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rinsed rice, water, and the slice of fresh ginger. Add a pinch of salt.

Bring the water to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan tightly with a lid, and let it simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until all the water is absorbed.
Once the water is absorbed, turn off the heat and let the rice steam, covered, for another 5-10 minutes. Do not lift the lid during this time.
Remove the slice of ginger before serving. Fluff the rice gently with a fork.

recipes.name: Quick Broccoli and Ginger Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil (like vegetable or canola)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the grated ginger and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chopped broccoli to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until it is bright green and slightly tender.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet. Break up any clumps of rice with your spoon and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, allowing the rice to heat through and get slightly crispy.
Pour the tamari over the rice and broccoli mixture. Stir well to combine everything evenly.
Continue to stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until everything is well mixed and heated through. Season with salt and pepper to your liking.
Serve hot immediately.

recipes.name: Beef and Potato Hash
ingredients: 200 g beef, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and lightly golden, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef pieces to the pan with the onions. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beef is browned on all sides, about 7-10 minutes.

Add the diced potatoes to the pan. Stir everything together, then cover the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. Let it cook for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and cooked through.
Season generously with salt and black pepper to your liking. Stir well to distribute the seasonings. Cook for another 1-2 minutes to let the flavors meld. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Simple Beef and Carrot Stew
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef cubes and brown them on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the beef and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the sliced carrots and cook for another 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return the browned beef to the pot. Add the cubed potatoes and pour in the water or beef broth. Bring the liquid to a simmer.

Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let the stew simmer gently for about 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes and carrots are tender and the beef is cooked through. Season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.name: Potato and Onion Fritters
instructions: Squeeze out as much liquid as possible from the grated potatoes using a clean kitchen towel or paper towels. In a bowl, combine the squeezed potatoes, finely chopped onion, and corn starch. If using, add the egg and mix everything together well.
Season the mixture generously with salt and black pepper. Stir to make sure the seasonings are evenly distributed.

Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Carefully drop spoonfuls of the potato and onion mixture into the hot oil, flattening them slightly with the back of the spoon.

Fry the fritters for about 3-5 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy. Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Tomato and Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook the gluten-free spaghetti according to package directions in salted boiling water until al dente. This usually takes about 8-12 minutes. Drain the pasta, reserving about half a cup of the cooking water, and set aside.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the skillet. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes start to break down and form a sauce. Season with salt and pepper to your liking.

Add the cooked gluten-free spaghetti to the skillet with the tomato sauce. Toss everything together to coat the pasta evenly. If the sauce seems a little dry, add a tablespoon or two of the reserved pasta water to loosen it up.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil just before serving. This will keep the basil's flavor bright and fresh. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Garlic Tomato Stew with Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and cook for about 1 minute until it smells fragrant, but don't let it brown.
Pour in the can of diced tomatoes with their juice. Add the drained and rinsed black-eyed peas. If you like a little heat, stir in the cayenne pepper now.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it cook for about 15 minutes. This allows the flavors to meld together.
Uncover the saucepan and continue to simmer for another 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the stew has thickened slightly. Season with salt and pepper to your taste.
Serve the stew hot. You can garnish with fresh basil if you have some, for an extra touch of freshness.

recipes.name: Simple Baked Eggplant with Tomato
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and use a spoon to scoop out most of the flesh, leaving about a 1/4-inch border around the edges to create a shell. Coarsely chop the scooped-out eggplant flesh.
Rub the inside of the eggplant shells with a little olive oil and place them cut-side up on a baking sheet. Set aside.
Heat the remaining olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

Add the chopped tomatoes and the chopped eggplant flesh to the skillet. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have softened and the eggplant is slightly tender. Season with salt and pepper.
Carefully spoon the tomato and eggplant mixture into the hollowed-out eggplant shells, filling them generously. Sprinkle a little more salt and pepper on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-35 minutes, or until the eggplant shells are tender when pierced with a fork and the filling is bubbly and heated through. Let cool slightly before serving.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Sugar Fried Eggs
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the cinnamon and sugar until well combined.
Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until it is shimmering.
Crack the eggs into the skillet, being careful not to break the yolks.
Cook for about 2-3 minutes, until the egg whites are mostly set.
Carefully flip the eggs using a spatula.
Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar mixture evenly over the eggs.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your liking.
Season with a little salt if desired, and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Simple Milk and Egg Custard
instructions: Warm the milk in a saucepan over medium heat until it just begins to bubble around the edges. Do not let it boil.
While the milk is warming, whisk the eggs and sugar together in a separate bowl until they are smooth and well combined.
Slowly pour about half a cup of the warm milk into the egg and sugar mixture, whisking constantly. This is called tempering and it prevents the eggs from cooking too quickly.
Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the saucepan with the rest of the warm milk. Add the cinnamon and a pinch of salt.

Cook over low heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the custard thickens enough to coat the back of the spoon. This should take about 10-15 minutes. Do not let it boil, or it might curdle.
Remove the custard from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving warm, or chill it in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Creamy Cinnamon Rice Pudding
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain it well.
In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, rinsed rice, sugar, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low.
Simmer for about 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is tender and the pudding has thickened. Make sure to stir from the bottom of the pan to prevent sticking.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg yolk until it's smooth.
Temper the egg yolk by slowly whisking in about half a cup of the hot pudding mixture. This prevents the yolk from scrambling.
Pour the tempered egg yolk mixture back into the saucepan with the rest of the pudding, stirring constantly.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring, until the pudding is heated through and slightly thicker. Do not let it boil.
Remove from heat and let it cool slightly before serving.

recipes.name: Lemon Dill Salmon with Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the potato chunks with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for about 20-25 minutes, until tender and slightly golden.
While the potatoes are roasting, pat the salmon fillets dry. Place them on a separate small baking dish or foil. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

Top the salmon with dill and lemon slices. Once the potatoes have about 10 minutes left, place the salmon in the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Serve the salmon immediately with the roasted potatoes.

recipes.name: Crispy Pan-Fried Potatoes with Lemon and Dill
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-sized cubes
instructions: Place the cubed potatoes in a pot of cold, salted water. Bring to a boil and cook for about 10 minutes, until they are just tender when pierced with a fork but not falling apart. Drain them very well.

Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the drained potatoes in a single layer, trying not to crowd the pan. Cook for about 8-10 minutes, flipping occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy on all sides.
Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the chopped dill, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Toss everything together gently for about 1 minute until the potatoes are evenly coated and fragrant.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Simple Lemon Dill Potato Mash
instructions: Place the quartered potatoes in a pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook for about 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are very tender when poked with a fork.
Drain the potatoes thoroughly and return them to the warm pot. Mash the potatoes with a potato masher or a fork until they are mostly smooth. Some small lumps are okay.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, chopped dill, salt, and pepper to the mashed potatoes. Stir everything together until well combined and creamy. The potatoes should look fluffy and moist.
Taste and add more salt, pepper, or lemon juice if needed. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions until al dente, which means it's cooked through but still has a slight bite. Reserve about half a cup of the pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it's fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and have released their liquid.
Pour in the coconut cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Stir in the nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper. Let it cook for 2-3 minutes until the sauce slightly thickens.

Add the drained pasta to the pan with the sauce. Toss everything together, adding a little of the reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too thick. Cook for another minute until the pasta is well coated.
Serve immediately, with an extra sprinkle of nutritional yeast if desired.

recipes.name: Garlicky Sautéed Mushrooms with Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until it's tender. Drain the pasta, reserving a little bit of the cooking water.
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until you can smell it, but don't let it turn brown.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet. Season them with salt and pepper, and cook for about 7-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are nicely browned and tender.
Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the mushrooms. Sprinkle in the nutritional yeast and toss everything together well.
If the pasta seems a bit dry, add a tablespoon or two of the reserved pasta water to help create a light sauce. Stir for another minute until everything is heated through.
Serve the pasta and mushrooms immediately.

recipes.name: Simple Garlic Mushrooms
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant, being careful not to let it burn.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the hot skillet. Season them with salt and black pepper.
Sauté the mushrooms for about 7-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and have turned a nice golden brown color.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Serve hot as a side dish or a light meal.

recipes.name: Dairy-Free Potato and Chive Mash
ingredients: 4 tablespoons oat milk or soy milk
instructions: Boil the potato cubes in a pot of salted water until they are very tender when poked with a fork, about 15-20 minutes. Drain the water completely.
Mash the potatoes in a bowl with a fork or potato masher. Add the olive oil and oat milk (or soy milk), mixing until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the chopped chives and season with salt and pepper to your liking. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Fried Potatoes with Chives
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced potatoes in a single layer, trying not to overcrowd the pan.
Cook the potatoes for about 10-12 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy. You may need to adjust the heat to prevent burning.
Once the potatoes are cooked through and nicely browned, remove them from the skillet and place them on a plate lined with paper towels to absorb excess oil.
Season generously with salt and pepper, then sprinkle with the chopped chives. Toss gently to combine and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Dairy-Free Potato and Chive Hash Browns
instructions: Grate the peeled potatoes using the large holes of a box grater. Squeeze out as much moisture as possible using your hands or a clean kitchen towel; this helps them crisp up.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the grated potatoes and spread them into an even layer.
Cook for about 8-10 minutes without stirring, until the bottom is golden brown and crispy. Carefully flip the hash browns using a spatula.
Cook the other side for another 7-9 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, and chopped chives. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Curried Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1 large chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 cups water or low-sodium vegetable broth
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Then add the chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat it with the spices and chicken.

Pour in the water or broth and season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.

recipes.name: Quick Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon curry powder (optional, for a twist)
2 tablespoons soy sauce (or tamari for gluten-free)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the sliced chicken breast and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.

Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-5 minutes. If using, stir in the curry powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and break up any clumps. Stir-fry for about 5 minutes until the rice is heated through and slightly toasted.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet. Pour in the soy sauce and season with salt and pepper. Stir everything together until well combined and heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Simple Curried Rice with Chicken
ingredients: 1 large chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook until it becomes soft and a little see-through, which should take about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook them until they are no longer pink on the outside, stirring occasionally. This will take about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for about 1 minute until you can smell its lovely aroma. Then, add the uncooked rice and stir it around to coat the grains with the spices and chicken.

Pour in the water and season with salt and pepper. Bring the water to a boil, then lower the heat, cover the pot tightly, and let it simmer gently for about 15-20 minutes, or until all the water is soaked up by the rice.
Once the rice is tender, turn off the heat and let it sit for a few minutes. Fluff the rice with a fork before serving.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Breakfast Patties
instructions: In a bowl, mash the banana until it's smooth. Add the oats, oat milk, and honey, then stir everything together until it forms a thick batter. Let it sit for about 5 minutes so the oats can absorb some of the liquid.

Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the batter for each patty into the hot skillet, flattening them slightly with the back of your spoon. Cook for about 3-4 minutes per side, until they are golden brown and cooked through.

recipes.name: Quick Banana Oat Drink
instructions: Place the oats, banana (broken into a few pieces), oat milk, and honey into a blender. Make sure your blender is sturdy enough for oats.

Blend on high speed for about 1-2 minutes, or until the mixture is smooth and creamy. If it seems too thick, you can add a little more oat milk until it reaches your desired consistency. Pour into two glasses and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Honey Banana Oat Clusters
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and lightly grease a baking sheet or line it with parchment paper. In a bowl, mash the banana until it's smooth, then stir in the honey and vegetable oil until well combined.

Add the oats to the banana mixture and stir until everything is coated and forms a sticky dough. Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving some space between them. Flatten each mound slightly with the back of your spoon.

Bake for about 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the clusters feel firm to the touch. Let them cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before carefully transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Cheesy Bacon and Spinach Egg Scramble
instructions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove the bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the bacon fat in the pan.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Remove the spinach and set aside with the bacon.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl until well combined. Pour the eggs into the same skillet over medium-low heat.
As the eggs begin to cook, gently stir and fold them. When the eggs are almost set but still slightly wet, stir in the cooked bacon, spinach, and cheese.
Continue to cook and stir until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through, about 1-2 more minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Crispy Bacon and Cheese Egg Patties
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, crumbled bacon, shredded cheese, salt, and pepper until well combined. Make sure the cheese and bacon are evenly distributed.
Heat the oil or butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Once hot, pour half of the egg mixture into the skillet to form one large patty.
Cook for about 4-5 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown and the edges start to look set. Gently flip the patty using a spatula.
Cook the other side for another 4-5 minutes, until the patty is cooked through and golden brown. Repeat with the remaining egg mixture to make a second patty.
Let the patties rest for a minute before serving. These are delicious on their own or with a side of greens.

recipes.name: Spinach and Cheese Baked Eggs
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat the oil or butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook until it's wilted, about 3-4 minutes. Season the spinach with salt and pepper.
Create two wells in the wilted spinach using the back of a spoon. Crack one egg into each well, being careful not to break the yolks.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese evenly over the spinach and around the eggs. Place the skillet in the preheated oven.
Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny, or cooked to your preference. Let it rest for a minute before serving.

recipes.name: Garlic Chicken Thighs with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel and season them generously with salt and pepper.

Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken thighs, skin-side down, for about 5-7 minutes until the skin is golden brown and crispy. Flip and sear the other side for 2 minutes.

Add the broccoli florets to the skillet around the chicken. Drizzle the broccoli with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Sprinkle the minced garlic over everything.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through (internal temperature reaches 165°F or 74°C) and the broccoli is tender-crisp.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving. Serve the chicken thighs with the roasted broccoli.

recipes.name: Keto Garlic Chicken with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs and cook for about 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through.

While the chicken is cooking, steam the broccoli florets until they are tender-crisp. You can do this in a steamer basket over boiling water for about 5-7 minutes, or in the microwave with a tablespoon of water for 3-4 minutes.
Once the chicken is almost done, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-60 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss to coat with the garlic oil. Cook for another minute.
Serve the garlic chicken thighs alongside the steamed broccoli.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Chicken with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for about 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet. Once melted, add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-60 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.

While the garlic is cooking, steam the broccoli florets until they are tender-crisp. You can do this in a steamer basket over boiling water for about 5-7 minutes, or in the microwave with a tablespoon of water for 3-4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and toss it in the garlic butter sauce. Let it cook for another minute to heat through.
Serve the garlic butter chicken alongside the steamed broccoli.

recipes.name: Butter-Seared Salmon with Asparagus and Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Prepare the cauliflower mash by boiling the cauliflower florets in salted water until very tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain well and mash with 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, and pepper until smooth and creamy. Keep warm.
While the cauliflower cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season the salmon filets with salt and pepper.
Sear the salmon, skin-side down if applicable, for about 4-5 minutes until the skin is crispy and golden. Flip the salmon and cook for another 3-4 minutes, or until cooked through to your liking.
In the same skillet (or a separate one), add the trimmed asparagus and a splash of water. Cook for 3-5 minutes until the asparagus is tender-crisp. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the seared salmon alongside the cauliflower mash and asparagus. Drizzle with any pan juices from the salmon.

recipes.name: Keto Asparagus and Salmon Skillet
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the asparagus pieces to the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes until they are just tender but still have a slight crisp. Season with salt and pepper.
Push the asparagus to one side of the skillet. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the empty side.
Season the salmon filets with salt and pepper. Place the salmon in the skillet with the butter and sear for about 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through and flaky.
Serve the salmon and asparagus directly from the skillet.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it's shimmering.
Season the salmon filets with salt and pepper. Carefully place the salmon into the hot skillet, skin-side down if it has skin, and sear for 4-5 minutes until the skin is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the salmon and cook for another 3-5 minutes, depending on thickness, until it's cooked through and flakes easily with a fork. Remove the salmon to a plate and keep warm.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the same skillet. Add the trimmed asparagus and cook for 3-5 minutes, tossing occasionally, until tender-crisp. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the pan-seared salmon alongside the buttered asparagus.

recipes.name: Keto Beef Lettuce Wraps with Tomato and Cheese
instructions: In a skillet, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Drain off any excess fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Cook for another minute until the spices are fragrant.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until it just starts to soften.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the shredded cheese until it begins to melt.
Spoon the beef mixture into the lettuce leaves. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cheesy Ground Beef and Tomato Skillet
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until it is browned, about 5-7 minutes. Drain off any extra grease.
Add the chopped tomatoes, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir everything together and cook for about 5 minutes, or until the tomatoes have softened.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the beef and tomato mixture. Cover the skillet and let it cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the cheesy beef and tomato mixture hot.

recipes.name: Keto Beef and Cheese Scramble
instructions: Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain off any excess fat.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet with the beef and cook for 1-2 minutes until slightly softened.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Pour the eggs over the beef and tomato mixture in the skillet.
As the eggs begin to cook, gently stir and fold them, similar to making scrambled eggs, until they are cooked through and set, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top and let it melt for about 30 seconds before serving.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Sautéed Apples and Onion
instructions: Pat the pork chops dry with a paper towel and season both sides generously with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers.

Carefully place the seasoned pork chops in the hot skillet. Cook for about 4-5 minutes per side, until nicely browned and cooked through. Remove the pork chops from the skillet and set aside on a plate.

Add the sliced apple and onion to the same skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes, until the apples are softened and the onions are tender and slightly caramelized.
Return the pork chops to the skillet with the apples and onions. Cook for another minute to allow the flavors to meld together. Serve the pork chops topped with the sautéed apples and onions.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Apple and Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork chops for 4-5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, then set aside.

While the pork chops cook, steam the cauliflower florets until very tender, about 10-15 minutes. Drain the cauliflower well and mash it with butter (if using), salt, and pepper until smooth and creamy. Keep warm.
In the same skillet used for the pork chops, add the diced apple and onion. Sauté over medium heat for about 5-7 minutes until softened and slightly caramelized.
Serve the pork chops alongside the cauliflower mash, topped with the sautéed apples and onions.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Sautéed Apples
instructions: Season both sides of the pork chops with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it is hot. Add the pork chops to the skillet.
Cook the pork chops for about 4-5 minutes per side, until they are golden brown and cooked through. Once cooked, remove the pork chops from the skillet and set them on a plate.

Add the sliced apples to the same skillet. Cook for about 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples are slightly softened and begin to turn golden. You can add a tiny splash of water if the pan seems too dry.
Return the pork chops to the skillet with the apples. Let them cook together for another minute to warm through. Serve the pork chops with the sautéed apples.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp with Zucchini Noodles
instructions: Prepare the zucchini noodles by spiralizing them or cutting them into thin strips. Set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the zucchini noodles to the skillet with the shrimp and garlic. Toss gently to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes, just until the zucchini is slightly softened but still has a bite.
Remove the skillet from the heat. Squeeze the lemon juice over the dish and toss everything together one last time.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Zucchini and Shrimp Sauté
ingredients: 2 medium zucchinis, cut into half-moon slices
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers.
Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant. Be careful not to let it burn.
Add the sliced zucchini to the skillet and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is tender-crisp.
Add the shrimp to the skillet with the zucchini. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, until they turn pink and are cooked through. Avoid overcooking the shrimp.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the lemon juice. Toss everything together to coat.
Taste and add more salt or pepper if needed. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Zucchini with Lemon and Garlic
ingredients: 2 medium zucchinis, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Season the shrimp with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute until fragrant, but not browned.
Add the zucchini pieces to the skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini is tender but still holds its shape.
Add the seasoned shrimp to the skillet with the zucchini. Cook for about 3-5 minutes, stirring gently, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the shrimp and zucchini mixture. Toss everything together to combine.
Taste the dish and add more salt, pepper, or lemon juice if needed. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Turkey and Lettuce Wraps with Tomato
instructions: Cook the ground turkey in a skillet with a little olive oil over medium heat until browned and cooked through. Season with salt and pepper to your liking.
While the turkey is cooking, chop the tomato. Wash and dry the lettuce leaves, setting them aside to use as wraps.
Once the turkey is cooked, drain any excess fat. Mix in the mayonnaise and chopped tomato with the turkey.
Spoon the turkey mixture into the lettuce leaves and fold them to create wraps. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Turkey and Tomato Lettuce Salad
ingredients: 200 g cooked turkey, shredded or diced
instructions: Prepare your ingredients: chop the lettuce and tomatoes, and ensure your turkey is cooked and ready to use (you can pan-fry or boil it if it's raw).
In a large bowl, combine the chopped lettuce, chopped tomatoes, and the cooked turkey.
In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise with salt and pepper to create a dressing. You can add a little water if you prefer a thinner dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently until everything is well coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Turkey Patties on Lettuce with Tomato
instructions: Form the ground turkey into two patties. Season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the turkey patties for about 5-7 minutes on each side, until they are cooked through and nicely browned.
While the patties are cooking, prepare the lettuce leaves by washing and drying them. Slice the tomato.
Place a cooked turkey patty on each lettuce leaf. Top with tomato slices and a dollop of mayonnaise. Fold the lettuce around the patty and toppings to serve.

recipes.name: Paleo Chicken and Sweet Potato Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 large sweet potato, peeled and diced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the diced sweet potato and cook for about 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften and get a little browned.

Add the chicken breast pieces to the skillet with the sweet potatoes. Season everything with salt and pepper. Continue to cook for another 10-15 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is cooked through and the sweet potatoes are tender.

recipes.name: Simple Salted Sweet Potato Fries
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into fries
2 tbsp cooking oil (like olive or avocado oil)
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the cut sweet potato fries with the cooking oil and salt on a baking sheet, making sure they are evenly coated.
Spread the fries in a single layer on the baking sheet. Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until they are tender on the inside and crispy on the outside.

recipes.name: Garlic Lemon Chicken Breast
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to create a marinade.

Place the chicken breasts in a shallow dish or a zip-top bag and pour the marinade over them. Make sure the chicken is well coated. Let it marinate for at least 10 minutes at room temperature, or longer in the refrigerator.

Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken breasts and cook for about 6-8 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and has a nice golden-brown color. The internal temperature should reach 165°F (74°C).

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-fry with Cashew Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup cashews, finely chopped or ground
1 tbsp cooking oil (like avocado or coconut oil)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the thinly sliced beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 3-5 minutes. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.

Add the broccoli florets to the same skillet. Stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes until they are bright green and slightly tender-crisp. If you are using garlic, add it in the last minute of cooking the broccoli.
In a small bowl, mix together the coconut aminos and the finely chopped or ground cashews. This will form your sauce.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet with the broccoli. Pour the cashew and coconut aminos sauce over the beef and broccoli.
Stir everything together to coat evenly. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly and the flavors to meld. Season with salt and pepper to your liking before serving.

recipes.name: Simple Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 250 g beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tbsp cooking oil (like avocado or olive oil)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or pan over medium-high heat. Add the beef pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 4-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the beef. Stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes, until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green. You can add a tablespoon of water if the pan gets too dry.
Pour the coconut aminos over the beef and broccoli. Stir well to coat everything evenly.
Continue to cook for another 1-2 minutes, allowing the coconut aminos to slightly caramelize and coat the ingredients. Taste and add more salt or pepper if needed, then serve immediately.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli with Almond Butter Glaze
ingredients: 1 tbsp cooking oil (like avocado or coconut oil)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the thinly sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-5 minutes. Remove the beef and set aside.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet and stir-fry for 4-6 minutes until tender-crisp. If using garlic, add it in the last minute of cooking the broccoli.
In a small bowl, whisk together the almond butter, coconut aminos, and 2 tablespoons of water until smooth. This creates your glaze.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet with the broccoli. Pour the almond butter glaze over everything.
Stir well to coat the beef and broccoli. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, allowing the glaze to thicken slightly and become glossy. Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving hot.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Spinach Scramble
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the fresh spinach to the pan with the mushrooms. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring, until the spinach has wilted down. Season with salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs until well combined. Pour the whisked eggs into the pan with the mushrooms and spinach.
Gently stir and fold the eggs as they cook, scrambling them with the vegetables. Continue cooking for about 3-5 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through to your liking. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Paleo Mushroom Steaks with Spinach
instructions: Gently clean the portobello mushrooms, remove the stems, and pat them dry. Brush both sides of the mushroom caps with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a grill pan or a large skillet over medium-high heat. Place the seasoned mushrooms, gill-side down, onto the hot surface.

Cook for about 5-7 minutes per side, until the mushrooms are tender and have developed nice grill marks or a golden-brown sear. While the mushrooms cook, you can gently warm the spinach in a separate small pan with a tiny bit of olive oil, salt, and pepper until just wilted.
Once cooked, remove the mushrooms from the pan and serve them topped with the wilted spinach.

recipes.name: Simple Sautéed Mushrooms and Spinach
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-45 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet. Season them with salt and pepper, and cook for about 7-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and have released their liquid.
Add the fresh spinach to the skillet with the cooked mushrooms. Stir gently until the spinach wilts, which should only take about 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed. Serve immediately as a delicious side dish or light meal.

recipes.name: Peanut Noodles with Tofu
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Cook the gluten-free noodles according to package directions, then drain and set aside. While the noodles cook, prepare the tofu by pressing out as much water as possible, then cutting it into bite-sized cubes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and sugar (if using) until smooth. Add a tablespoon or two of water to reach a sauce-like consistency.
Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes and cook for about 5-7 minutes, flipping occasionally, until golden brown and slightly crispy on all sides.

Add the cooked noodles and the peanut sauce to the pan with the tofu. Toss everything together gently until the noodles and tofu are well coated in the sauce. Cook for another 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Serve immediately, with an extra squeeze of lime if desired.

recipes.name: Lime Marinated Tofu Steaks
instructions: Press the tofu firmly to remove as much water as possible, then cut it into two thick steaks or four smaller cutlets. In a shallow dish, whisk together the tamari, lime juice, and peanut butter to create a marinade.

Place the tofu steaks in the marinade, ensuring they are well coated. Let them marinate for at least 15 minutes, flipping halfway through. If you have more time, you can marinate them longer in the refrigerator.
Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully place the marinated tofu steaks in the hot pan.
Sear the tofu for about 4-5 minutes per side, until golden brown and firm. You can spoon some of the extra marinade over the tofu as it cooks, but be mindful that the peanut butter can burn.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve the tofu steaks immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Peanut Dipping Sauce with Lime
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and sugar (if using). Stir with a spoon or whisk until the mixture is mostly combined, but it might still be quite thick.

Gradually add the warm water, one tablespoon at a time, stirring continuously. Keep adding water and mixing until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. It should be smooth and pourable, like a thick dressing.
Taste the sauce and adjust the flavors if needed. You might want a little more lime for tartness, more tamari for saltiness, or more sugar for sweetness.
This sauce is ready to be used immediately as a dip for vegetables or tofu, or as a dressing for salads and noodles.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to package directions in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside, reserving about half a cup of the pasta water.

While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the same skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and have released their liquid, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour the coconut cream into the skillet with the mushrooms. Stir well and bring to a gentle simmer. Let it cook for 2-3 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet. Stir to coat everything in the creamy sauce. If the sauce is too thick, add a little of the reserved pasta water to reach your desired consistency.
Add the cooked gluten-free pasta to the skillet with the chicken and mushroom sauce. Toss everything together until the pasta is well coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Garlic Mushroom Chicken Stir-fry
ingredients: 2 boneless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips
1 tbsp soy sauce (use tamari for gluten-free)
1 tsp ginger, grated (optional, common pantry staple)
Cooked rice for serving (user needs to provide or use common pantry staple like rice)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry until they are cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.

Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender and slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet with the mushrooms and garlic. Stir in the soy sauce (or tamari) and grated ginger if using. Season with salt and pepper to your liking.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring everything together to ensure the sauce coats the chicken and mushrooms. Serve immediately over cooked rice.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Seared Chicken with Sautéed Mushrooms
instructions: Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and season them generously on both sides with salt and black pepper. This helps create a nice crust.

Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Carefully place the chicken breasts in the hot skillet and cook for about 6-8 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. The internal temperature should reach 165°F (74°C). Remove the chicken from the skillet and let it rest on a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the same skillet. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and begin to brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet with the mushrooms and cook for about 30-60 seconds, until it's fragrant. Be careful not to burn the garlic.
Season the mushrooms with a pinch of salt and pepper. You can add a splash of water if the pan looks dry.
Slice the rested chicken breasts and serve them alongside the sautéed garlic mushrooms.

recipes.name: Quick Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 tbsp vegan pesto (or 1/4 cup fresh basil, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp pine nuts, blended)
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente, which means it's cooked through but still has a slight bite. Reserve about half a cup of the pasta water before draining.

While the pasta cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for about 5-7 minutes, until they start to soften and release their juices. Stir occasionally.

Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the tomatoes. Stir in the vegan pesto and toss everything together to coat the pasta evenly. If the sauce seems too thick, add a little of the reserved pasta water, a tablespoon at a time, until it reaches your desired consistency.
Stir in most of the toasted pine nuts, reserving some for garnish. Season with salt to taste.
Serve the pasta immediately, garnished with the remaining toasted pine nuts.
rules: Vegan: "Quick Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Pine Nuts" (pesto)

recipes.name: Pasta with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes and Pine Nuts
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the whole cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. If you have garlic, mince it and add it to the tomatoes.

Roast the tomatoes for about 15-20 minutes, or until they are softened and slightly burst. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente. Reserve about half a cup of pasta water before draining.
Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Add the roasted tomatoes and their juices to the pasta. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and toss everything together well.
Stir in most of the toasted pine nuts, reserving some for garnish. If the pasta seems a little dry, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to create a light sauce.
Serve the pasta immediately, garnished with the remaining toasted pine nuts. Add more salt and pepper if needed.

recipes.name: Simple Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Pine Nuts
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente, meaning it's cooked through but still has a slight bite. Reserve about half a cup of the pasta water before draining.

While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften and release their juices.

Add the drained pasta directly to the skillet with the tomatoes. Toss everything together to combine. If the pasta seems a bit dry, add a tablespoon or two of the reserved pasta water to create a light sauce.
Stir in most of the toasted pine nuts, reserving a small amount for garnish. Season generously with salt and black pepper to your liking.
Serve the pasta immediately in bowls, topped with the remaining toasted pine nuts.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Romaine Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, rinsed chickpeas, and croutons.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper until well combined. This will be your bright and tangy dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently until everything is evenly coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Romaine Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, rinsed chickpeas, and croutons.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper until well combined. This will be your bright and tangy dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently until everything is evenly coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Romaine Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, rinsed chickpeas, and croutons.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper until well combined. This will be your bright and tangy dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently until everything is evenly coated. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Simple Chicken and Root Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 gluten-free stock cube or 1 cup gluten-free broth
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook until they are lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot. Stir everything together with the chicken.

Dissolve the gluten-free stock cube in 2 cups of hot water (or use 2 cups of gluten-free broth). Pour this liquid into the pot, making sure the vegetables and chicken are mostly covered. Add more water if needed.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it cook for about 20 minutes, or until the potatoes and carrots are tender when poked with a fork.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir well and let it cook for another 2 minutes before serving hot.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Chicken with Roasted Potatoes and Carrots
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut in half horizontally
2 carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the cubed potatoes and carrot pieces with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Spread them in a single layer.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until they are tender and slightly browned.
While the vegetables roast, pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels and season them generously with salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully place the chicken breasts in the hot skillet.
Cook the chicken for about 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. The internal temperature should reach 165°F (74°C).
Serve the pan-fried chicken immediately with the roasted potatoes and carrots on the side.

recipes.name: Hearty Mashed Potatoes and Carrots
instructions: Place the quartered potatoes in a pot and cover them with cold water. Add a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook for about 15-20 minutes, until they are very tender when poked with a fork.
While the potatoes cook, place the chopped carrots in a separate small pot and cover them with water. Bring to a boil and cook for about 10-15 minutes, until the carrots are tender.
Drain the potatoes well, letting them sit in the colander for a minute to steam dry. Drain the carrots, reserving a little of their cooking water.
Mash the potatoes in the pot using a potato masher or a fork until they are mostly smooth. Add the cooked carrots to the pot with the potatoes.

Mash the carrots into the potatoes. Add a little of the reserved carrot cooking water, or more regular water, a tablespoon at a time, until you reach your desired mashed consistency. Stir in the olive oil if using.
Season the mash with salt and pepper to your taste. Stir well and serve warm.

recipes.name: Chocolate Strawberry Cream Parfait
ingredients: 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped or shaved
instructions: In a chilled bowl, whip the heavy cream with an electric mixer or whisk until it forms soft peaks. This means the cream will hold its shape loosely when the whisk is lifted. Gently fold in the powdered sugar and vanilla extract, if using, until just combined. Be careful not to overmix, or the cream can become grainy.

Wash and slice the fresh strawberries. Melt the dark chocolate gently in a small bowl over a pot of simmering water (double boiler method) or in the microwave in short bursts, stirring in between, until smooth. To assemble, layer half of the sliced strawberries in the bottom of two serving glasses or bowls. Top with half of the whipped cream, then drizzle with some of the melted dark chocolate.

Repeat the layers with the remaining strawberries, whipped cream, and dark chocolate. You can also add the chopped dark chocolate between layers or sprinkle it on top for extra texture. Chill the parfaits for at least 10 minutes before serving for the best flavor and texture.

recipes.name: Quick Chocolate Strawberry Skillet Bake
ingredients: 1 cup fresh strawberries, halved or quartered
Optional: A few vegan marshmallows for topping
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F). In an oven-safe skillet or small baking dish, combine the chopped dark chocolate and heavy cream. Stir gently until the chocolate is mostly coated by the cream.

Place the skillet or baking dish in the preheated oven and bake for about 8-10 minutes, or until the chocolate is melted and smooth. Carefully remove from the oven. Stir the melted chocolate and cream together until it forms a smooth, glossy sauce.

Arrange the fresh strawberries on top of the warm chocolate sauce. If you are using vegan marshmallows, scatter them over the strawberries. Return the dish to the oven for another 2-3 minutes, just until the marshmallows are puffed and slightly golden, or the strawberries are warmed through. Serve immediately with a spoon.

recipes.name: Strawberry Chocolate Swirl Smoothie
instructions: In a blender, combine the heavy cream, milk, and frozen strawberries. Add sugar or sweetener if you prefer a sweeter smoothie. Blend on low speed for about 30 seconds until the ingredients start to break down.

Increase the blender speed to high and blend for another 1 minute, or until the smoothie is completely smooth and creamy. If the smoothie is too thick, you can add a little more milk or water until it reaches your desired consistency.

Gently melt the dark chocolate using a microwave in short bursts or a double boiler, stirring until smooth. Pour half of the smoothie into a glass. Drizzle half of the melted chocolate over the smoothie. Pour the remaining smoothie into the glass and drizzle the rest of the chocolate on top. You can use a spoon or toothpick to create a swirl effect before serving.

recipes.name: Spinach Chickpea Curry with Corn Tortillas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup water (or vegetable broth if available)
instructions: Warm the cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the curry paste and stir for about 1 minute until it becomes fragrant. Be careful not to burn it.
Add the drained and rinsed chickpeas and the water to the pan. Stir everything together and bring it to a gentle simmer.
