Let the curry simmer for about 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the chickpeas to heat through. If the sauce seems too thick, add a little more water.
Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for another 2-3 minutes, just until the spinach wilts down into the curry. Season with salt to your liking.
While the curry is simmering, warm the corn tortillas. You can do this in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side, or wrap them in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 seconds.
Serve the hot chickpea and spinach curry immediately with the warm corn tortillas on the side for scooping.

recipes.name: Quick Chickpea and Spinach Curry
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the curry paste and cook for about 1 minute, stirring constantly until it smells fragrant.
Add the drained and rinsed chickpeas and the water to the pan. Stir well to combine with the curry paste.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for about 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to deepen and the chickpeas to heat through. If it looks too dry, add a splash more water.
Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for just 2-3 minutes more, until the spinach has wilted into the curry.
Season the curry with salt to your preference.
Serve the curry hot, perhaps over rice if you have some, or on its own.

recipes.name: Spinach and Chickpea Stew
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a pot or deep pan over medium heat. Add the curry paste and stir for about a minute until it releases its aroma.
Add the drained chickpeas and the water to the pot. Stir everything together well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for about 10 minutes, allowing the chickpeas to soften slightly and absorb the curry flavors.
Add the fresh spinach to the pot, a handful at a time if necessary, stirring it in as it wilts.
Continue to cook for another 3-5 minutes until the spinach is tender and the stew has thickened slightly. Add salt to taste.
Serve the spinach and chickpea stew hot.

recipes.name: Vegan Kimchi Tofu Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 block (about 300g) firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the tofu from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped kimchi to the same pan and stir-fry for about 2 minutes until fragrant. Be sure to use vegan kimchi that does not contain fish sauce.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and break up any clumps. Stir well to combine with the kimchi, cooking for about 5 minutes until the rice is heated through.
Return the cooked tofu to the pan. Add most of the chopped spring onions (save some for garnish) and stir everything together for another 2-3 minutes.
Season the fried rice with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir well to distribute the seasonings evenly.
Serve the fried rice hot, garnished with the remaining chopped spring onions.

recipes.name: Simple Tofu and Spring Onion Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 block (about 300g) firm tofu, pressed and sliced
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the sliced tofu and cook for about 4-5 minutes per side, until golden brown and slightly crispy.
While the tofu is cooking, prepare your rice. You can warm it up in a separate pot or microwave if it's not already hot.
Once the tofu is nicely browned, remove it from the pan. You can cut it into bite-sized pieces if you prefer.
In the same pan, add the cooked rice and stir gently for about 2 minutes to heat it through. You can add a tiny bit more oil if the pan seems dry.
Add the cooked tofu and most of the chopped spring onions to the rice. Stir everything together until well combined and heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve the rice mixture in bowls, topped with the remaining fresh spring onions.

recipes.name: Tofu and Spring Onion Stir-fry with Rice
ingredients: 1 block (about 300g) firm tofu, pressed and cubed
4 spring onions, chopped (separate white and green parts)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and stir-fry until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the tofu and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the pan. Add the white parts of the chopped spring onions and stir-fry for about 1 minute until they are fragrant.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir well, breaking up any clumps. Cook for about 3-5 minutes until the rice is heated through.
Return the cooked tofu to the pan. Add the green parts of the spring onions and stir everything together for another 2-3 minutes until well combined.
Season the stir-fry with salt and pepper to your preference. Make sure to taste and adjust as needed.
Serve the tofu and spring onion stir-fry immediately over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Tofu and Broccoli Stir-fry with Rice
ingredients: 1 block (about 300g) firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. Typically, this involves rinsing the rice, then combining it with water in a pot and bringing it to a boil, followed by simmering until the water is absorbed.

While the rice cooks, prepare the tofu. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until it's golden brown and slightly crispy on all sides, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the tofu. Stir-fry for about 3-5 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp.

Pour the soy sauce over the tofu and broccoli. If you like, add a pinch of black pepper. Stir everything together to coat evenly, and cook for another 1-2 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the tofu and broccoli stir-fry immediately over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Sticky Soy Glazed Tofu with Rice
ingredients: 1 block (about 300g) firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 tbsp maple syrup or agave syrup (instead of honey)
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. This usually involves rinsing the rice, then boiling it with water and simmering until tender.
While the rice is cooking, prepare the glaze. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, maple syrup (or agave syrup), and water.
Heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown and crispy on all sides, about 7-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Once the tofu is crispy, pour the soy sauce mixture over it. Stir gently to coat the tofu evenly. Let it simmer for 1-2 minutes until the glaze thickens and coats the tofu nicely.
Serve the sticky glazed tofu over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Steamed Rice with Savory Tofu Crumble
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. This usually involves rinsing the rice, then boiling it with water and simmering until tender.
While the rice cooks, prepare the tofu crumble. Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the crumbled tofu to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, for about 5-7 minutes until it starts to dry out and lightly brown.
Stir in the soy sauce and a pinch of black pepper, if using. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring, until the tofu is evenly coated and has a savory aroma.
Serve the savory tofu crumble over the steamed rice.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Spinach Sauté
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it becomes soft and see-through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for about 1 minute until you can smell its fragrance, being careful not to let it burn.
Stir in the rinsed and drained chickpeas and cook for about 5 minutes, allowing them to warm through and get slightly tender.
Add the spinach to the skillet, a handful at a time, stirring until it wilts down. This should only take a few minutes.
Season the sauté with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir everything together one last time.
Serve hot as a light meal or side dish.

recipes.name: Garlicky Chickpea and Spinach Stew
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it's soft and clear, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant, making sure it doesn't brown.
Add the drained and rinsed chickpeas and the water or vegetable broth to the pot. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Let the chickpeas simmer for about 10-15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together. The liquid should reduce slightly.
Add the spinach to the pot, a handful at a time, stirring it in as it wilts. This will only take a few minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to your taste. Stir everything well.
Serve the warm stew immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Garlic and Onion Sautéed Spinach
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced onion and cook until it softens and becomes a little see-through, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for about 30-60 seconds until it's fragrant. Be careful not to let it burn, as it can become bitter.
Add the spinach to the skillet. You might need to add it in batches if your pan is full. Stir gently as it wilts down, which should only take 2-3 minutes.
Once the spinach is tender, season it with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir everything together well.
Serve immediately as a delicious side dish.

recipes.name: Simple Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions until it is al dente, which means it's cooked but still has a slight bite.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute until it smells fragrant, being careful not to let it burn.
Add the chopped tomatoes to the skillet with the garlic and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they soften and start to break down, creating a sauce.
Drain the pasta, reserving about half a cup of the starchy cooking water. Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the tomato sauce.
Stir in the nutritional yeast and chopped fresh basil. Add a little of the reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too dry, tossing everything together until the pasta is well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking. Serve immediately, garnished with a little extra basil if you have it.

recipes.name: Quick Tomato and Basil Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1 tbsp lemon juice (optional, if you have it)
instructions: Place the couscous in a heatproof bowl. Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover the bowl tightly with a lid or plate, and let it sit for about 5 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the couscous is tender.
Fluff the couscous with a fork to separate the grains. Add the diced tomatoes, chopped fresh basil, and olive oil to the bowl with the couscous.
If you have lemon juice, add it now for a bit of tang. Gently toss all the ingredients together until everything is well combined.
Season the salad with salt and pepper to your taste. Serve slightly warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Simple Sautéed Vegetables with Tomato
ingredients: 1/2 tsp dried oregano (optional, if you have it)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped tomatoes to the skillet.
Cook the tomatoes for about 7-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften and release their juices, forming a light sauce.
If you have dried oregano, sprinkle it into the pan now and stir it through.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to your liking. Cook for another minute or two to let the flavors meld.
Serve this simple tomato mixture as a side dish.

recipes.name: Spicy Potato and Bell Pepper Hash
ingredients: 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional, for spice)
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the diced potatoes and cook for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and starting to turn golden brown.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet with the potatoes. Continue to cook for another 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables are softened and slightly caramelized.
If you like a little heat, stir in the red pepper flakes. Season generously with salt and black pepper to your taste. Cook for another minute or two to let the flavors meld together.
Serve the hash hot as a delicious breakfast, brunch, or side dish.

recipes.name: Simple Potato and Bell Pepper Saute
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 bell pepper, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Boil the potato pieces in salted water for about 10-12 minutes until they are just tender when pierced with a fork. Drain them well and set aside.
While the potatoes are boiling, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook for about 5 minutes until it starts to soften and become translucent.
Add the bell pepper pieces to the skillet and cook for another 5-7 minutes until they are tender-crisp. Stir in the pre-cooked potato pieces.
Season everything with salt and black pepper. Cook for an additional 3-5 minutes, stirring gently, until the potatoes are lightly golden and everything is heated through. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Vegan Potato and Bell Pepper Hash Browns
instructions: Squeeze out as much moisture as possible from the grated potatoes using a clean kitchen towel or paper towels. This is key for crispy hash browns.
In a bowl, mix the grated potatoes with the finely diced bell pepper and onion. Season with salt and black pepper.
Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully add the potato mixture to the skillet, spreading it into an even layer.

Cook for about 7-10 minutes per side, without stirring too much, until the hash browns are golden brown and crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. Flip carefully to brown the other side. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Coconut Lentil Curry
instructions: Warm the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the chopped onion and diced carrot. Cook until the onion is soft and see-through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the curry powder and stir it around for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant. This helps to wake up the spices.
Pour in the rinsed lentils, coconut milk, and water. Stir everything together well.

Bring the mixture to a boil, then lower the heat, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and have absorbed most of the liquid. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.
Taste the curry and add salt if needed. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Quick Carrot and Lentil Stew
instructions: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it softens, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced carrot and curry powder to the pot. Stir and cook for another minute until the curry powder is fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils and water to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until the lentils are starting to soften.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir well. Continue to simmer, uncovered, for another 5-10 minutes until the lentils are fully tender and the stew has thickened slightly. Add salt to taste.
Serve warm.

recipes.name: Spiced Lentils with Coconut Carrot
instructions: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and lightly golden, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the grated carrot and curry powder. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils and water to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the lentils are almost tender.

Pour in the coconut milk and stir well. Continue to cook uncovered for another 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are fully cooked and the stew has thickened to your liking. Season with salt.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Onion Rice Pilaf
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions using water and a pinch of salt. While the rice is cooking, heat the olive oil in a separate pan over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onion and sauté until they are softened and lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.

Once the rice is cooked and the mushrooms and onions are ready, stir them into the cooked rice. Mix in the grated parmesan cheese until melted and combined. Season with salt and black pepper to your liking and serve hot.

recipes.name: Simple Mushroom and Onion Sauté
instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and diced onion.
Sauté for about 7-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and the onions are softened and lightly golden. Season with salt and black pepper to taste before serving.

recipes.name: Savory Rice with Mushrooms and Onion
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water. In a medium pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5-7 minutes.

Add the rinsed rice to the pot with the vegetables and stir for about a minute until the grains are lightly toasted. Pour in the water and add salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.

recipes.name: Cheesy Tomato Melts
instructions: Toast the bread slices until they are golden brown and slightly crisp. You can do this in a toaster, under a broiler, or in a dry pan.
While the bread is toasting, lightly brush the tomato slices with olive oil and season them with salt and pepper. You can also gently warm them in a pan for a minute if you prefer.
Once the bread is toasted, layer the cheese slices on top of two of the slices. Then, arrange the seasoned tomato slices over the cheese.
Place the remaining two slices of bread on top to make sandwiches. You can lightly butter the outside of the sandwiches if you like for extra crispiness when grilling.

Cook the sandwiches in a lightly oiled pan over medium-low heat, or in a panini press, for about 3-5 minutes per side, or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is completely melted and gooey. Press down gently with a spatula while cooking.
Once grilled to perfection, remove from the pan, let cool for a minute, and then slice in half to serve.

recipes.name: Simple Tomato and Cheese Flatbread
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F) or preheat a grill pan over medium heat.
Brush the bread slices lightly with olive oil on both sides. Place them on a baking sheet or directly on the grill pan.
Arrange the tomato slices over the bread, then generously top with cheese. Season with a little salt and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 10-15 minutes, or grill for about 5-7 minutes per side, until the bread is golden and toasted, and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Keep an eye on it to prevent burning. The cheese should be nicely melted and the tomatoes softened.
Once ready, carefully remove from the oven or grill pan and let it cool slightly before slicing and serving.

recipes.name: Smoky Tomato and Cheese Toast
instructions: Toast the bread slices until they are golden brown and crisp. You can use a toaster, oven, or a dry pan for this.

While the bread is toasting, gently warm the diced tomato in a small pan with the olive oil. Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for about 2-3 minutes until the tomatoes are slightly softened and fragrant.
Once the bread is toasted, spoon the warm, seasoned tomato mixture evenly over the slices.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the tomatoes on each slice of toast.
Place the toast under a preheated broiler (grill) for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Watch carefully to prevent burning.
Serve immediately while the cheese is still melted and warm.

recipes.name: Garlicky Cabbage Noodles with Egg
instructions: Cook the noodles according to package directions until they are tender. Drain them well and set aside. While the noodles are cooking, prepare the cabbage and garlic.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of cooking oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant, being careful not to let it burn.
Add the thinly sliced cabbage to the pan with the garlic. Stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender-crisp. This means it should be soft but still have a slight bite.

Add the cooked noodles to the pan with the cabbage and garlic. Stir everything together to combine. In a small bowl, mix together 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of lime juice, then add this to the pan to season the noodles and cabbage.
Stir well to ensure everything is coated and heated through. Taste and add a little more salt if needed. Now, in a separate small pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Crack the 2 eggs into the hot pan and fry them until they are cooked to your liking – sunny-side up, over-easy, or however you prefer. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper if desired.
Divide the noodle and cabbage mixture between two bowls. Carefully place a fried egg on top of each serving. Serve immediately and enjoy this flavorful vegetarian noodle dish.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Cabbage and Egg Wraps
ingredients: 1 tbsp cooking oil, plus more for frying
instructions: First, let's make the thin crepes. In a bowl, whisk together the egg, flour, and water until you have a smooth batter with no lumps. Add a pinch of salt.

Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour about 1/4 cup of batter into the pan and swirl it around to create a thin, even layer. Cook for about 1-2 minutes until the edges look dry, then flip and cook for another minute until lightly golden.
Repeat this process with the rest of the batter until you have about 4-6 thin crepes. Set them aside on a plate. Now, prepare the filling.
Heat 1 tablespoon of cooking oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for about 15 seconds until fragrant.
Add the shredded cabbage to the pan. Stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes until the cabbage is tender but still a little crisp.
Season the cabbage mixture with salt and pepper. Stir well to combine and cook for another minute.

To assemble, place about 2-3 tablespoons of the cabbage filling in the center of a crepe. Fold in the sides and then roll it up tightly to form a spring roll. You can use a tiny bit of flour mixed with water to seal the edge if needed.
Serve the vegetarian cabbage and egg wraps immediately. They are delicious on their own or with a dipping sauce if you have one.

recipes.name: Simple Garlic and Cabbage Egg Scramble
instructions: In a bowl, crack the 3 eggs. Add a pinch of salt and pepper. Whisk them together until the yolks and whites are well combined and slightly foamy. Set aside.
Heat the cooking oil or butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Once the oil is shimmering or the butter is melted, add the minced garlic.
Stir the garlic for about 30 seconds until you can smell its aroma, but be careful not to let it turn brown.
Add the shredded cabbage to the pan with the garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes until the cabbage is softened but still has a slight crispness.
Pour the whisked eggs over the cabbage and garlic in the pan. Let the eggs cook undisturbed for about 1 minute until the edges begin to set.
Gently stir and fold the eggs and cabbage mixture with a spatula. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are cooked through and no longer runny. This should take about 3-4 minutes.
Taste and add more salt and pepper if needed. Serve the scrambled eggs and cabbage mixture immediately.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Corn Tostadas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 cup frozen or canned corn, drained
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Lightly brush the tortillas with olive oil on both sides and place them on a baking sheet. Bake for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through, until they are golden brown and crispy. These are your tostada shells.

While the tortillas are baking, warm the olive oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add the drained black beans and corn, along with chili powder if you are using it. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until everything is heated through.

Once the tostada shells are crisp, remove them from the oven. Spoon the warm black bean and corn mixture onto each tostada shell. Top with slices of avocado and a sprinkle of shredded cheese. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Corn and Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 cup frozen or canned corn, drained
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rinsed black beans and the drained corn. If using frozen corn, make sure it's thawed.
Add the diced avocado and shredded cheese to the bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and lime juice if you have it. Season with salt and pepper to your liking.
Gently toss everything together until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Serve immediately as a side dish or a light meal.

recipes.name: Cheesy Corn and Black Bean Quesadillas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 cup frozen or canned corn, drained
instructions: In a bowl, mix the rinsed black beans, drained corn, and cumin if you are using it. Stir to combine evenly.
Lay two tortillas flat. Spread half of the black bean and corn mixture over one half of each tortilla. Sprinkle half of the shredded cheese over the bean and corn mixture on each tortilla.

Fold the other half of each tortilla over the filling to create a half-moon shape. Heat the olive oil or butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook each quesadilla for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted and gooey. Cut into wedges and serve warm.

recipes.name: Ginger Soy Chicken and Broccoli Stir-fry with Rice
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tablespoon cooking oil (like vegetable or canola)
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. While the rice is cooking, prepare the stir-fry.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamari and grated ginger. Set aside.
Heat the cooking oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the chicken. Stir-fry for another 3-5 minutes, until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green.
Pour the tamari-ginger sauce over the chicken and broccoli. Stir well to coat everything evenly and cook for 1-2 minutes more until the sauce has slightly thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking.
Serve the chicken and broccoli stir-fry over the cooked rice.

recipes.name: Steamed Rice
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. This helps remove excess starch, making the rice fluffier.
Combine the rinsed rice, water, and salt (if using) in a saucepan.

Bring the water to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat to the lowest setting, cover the pot tightly with a lid, and let it simmer for about 15 minutes, or until all the water is absorbed.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it sit, covered, for another 5 minutes. This allows the rice to steam and become perfectly tender.
Fluff the rice gently with a fork before serving.

recipes.name: Ginger Garlic Broccoli
instructions: Place the broccoli florets in a steamer basket over a pot of boiling water. Cover and steam for about 5-7 minutes, until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp.
While the broccoli is steaming, heat the cooking oil in a small skillet over medium heat. Add the minced ginger and garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn them.
Once the broccoli is steamed, add it to the skillet with the ginger and garlic. Toss gently to coat the broccoli with the fragrant oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Beef and Potato Hash
ingredients: 200 g beef, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.

Add the chopped onion to the same skillet and cook until softened and lightly golden, about 5 minutes. Add the diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and browned, about 15-20 minutes.
Return the browned beef to the skillet with the potatoes and onions. Season generously with salt and pepper. Stir everything together and cook for another 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Serve the beef and potato hash hot.

recipes.name: Simple Beef and Vegetable Mash
ingredients: 2 medium carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
150 g beef, cooked and cubed (leftovers work well)
instructions: Place the potatoes in a pot, cover with water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a boil. Cook until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain well.

While the potatoes are cooking, place the carrots and onions in another pot, cover with water, and add a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook until the carrots are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain, reserving about 1/4 cup of the cooking water.
Mash the cooked potatoes until smooth. Add the cooked carrots and onions and mash them into the potatoes. Stir in the cooked beef cubes.
Add a little of the reserved cooking water, if needed, to reach a nice mashed consistency. Stir in the cooking oil or butter, and season with salt and pepper to your liking. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Potato and Beef Patties
ingredients: 2 medium potatoes, peeled and boiled until soft
150 g beef, cooked and finely chopped or ground
instructions: Mash the boiled potatoes in a bowl until smooth. Make sure there are no large lumps. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the finely chopped or ground beef and the finely chopped onion to the mashed potatoes. Mix everything together thoroughly until well combined.
Divide the mixture into two equal portions and shape them into patties, about 1 inch thick. You can gently flatten them with your hands.

Heat the cooking oil in a skillet over medium heat. Carefully place the patties in the hot skillet and cook for about 6-8 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and heated through. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Tomato and Garlic Noodles
ingredients: 200 g gluten-free pasta (like rice noodles or gluten-free spaghetti)
instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to package directions in boiling salted water. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.

Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells fragrant, being careful not to let it burn. Add the chopped tomatoes, salt, and pepper, and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes have softened and created a light sauce. Stir in the fresh basil.
Drain the cooked gluten-free pasta and add it directly to the pan with the tomato and garlic sauce. Toss everything together gently to coat the pasta evenly. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Tomato Garlic Beans
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans or other white beans, drained and rinsed
1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional, for a little heat)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, making sure it doesn't turn brown.

Add the chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using) to the skillet. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes start to break down and form a light sauce.
Stir in the drained and rinsed beans and cook for another 5 minutes, allowing them to heat through and absorb the flavors. Stir in the fresh basil just before serving. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Garlic Tomato Eggplant
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, plus more for rubbing
1/4 tsp black pepper, or to taste
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and use a spoon to scoop out most of the flesh, leaving about a 1/4-inch border to create a shell. Coarsely chop the scooped-out eggplant flesh.

Rub the inside of the eggplant shells with a little olive oil and place them on a baking sheet. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

Add the chopped eggplant flesh and chopped tomatoes to the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the eggplant is slightly tender and the tomatoes have softened.

Spoon the cooked eggplant and tomato mixture evenly into the prepared eggplant shells. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-35 minutes, or until the eggplant shells are tender when pierced with a fork. Sprinkle with fresh basil before serving.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Sugar French Toast
instructions: In a shallow dish, whisk together the eggs, milk, cinnamon, and half of the sugar until well combined. This will be the batter for your French toast.
Dip each slice of gluten-free bread into the egg mixture, making sure both sides are coated. Let any excess batter drip off.
Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. The butter should sizzle gently.
Place the coated bread slices onto the hot skillet. Cook for about 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. The bread should feel slightly firm to the touch.
Once cooked, remove the French toast from the skillet and place it on a plate. Sprinkle the remaining sugar over the top, and serve warm.

recipes.name: Simple Egg and Milk Pudding
instructions: Preheat your oven to 325°F (160°C).
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, cinnamon, and sugar until everything is smoothly combined and no sugar lumps remain.
Melt the butter and lightly grease two ramekins or small oven-safe dishes. Pour the egg and milk mixture evenly into the prepared dishes.

Place the ramekins in a larger baking dish and carefully pour hot water into the larger dish until it comes halfway up the sides of the ramekins. This is called a water bath and helps the pudding cook gently.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is just barely jiggly when you gently shake the dish. The pudding should look mostly firm.
Carefully remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool slightly before serving warm, or chill them in the refrigerator for a firmer texture.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Creamy Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon (optional, for a hint of warmth)
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk until they are well blended. If you're using cinnamon, add it now and whisk it in.
Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat until it's foamy but not browned. The pan should be warm, not scorching hot.
Pour the egg mixture into the warm skillet. Let the eggs cook undisturbed for about 30 seconds, until the edges just begin to set.
Gently push the cooked egg from the edges toward the center with a spatula, tilting the pan to allow the uncooked egg to flow underneath. Continue this process slowly and gently.
Keep stirring and folding the eggs until they are mostly cooked but still look a little moist and creamy. This should only take a few minutes. Avoid overcooking them until they are dry.
Remove the skillet from the heat immediately to stop the cooking process. Serve the creamy scrambled eggs right away.

recipes.name: Lemon Dill Salmon with Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the potato wedges with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet, and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until tender and golden brown.
While the potatoes are roasting, pat the salmon fillets dry. Season them with salt and pepper, then place them in a small bowl.
In the same bowl, add the lemon juice, chopped dill, and the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Gently toss to coat the salmon.
About 10-15 minutes before the potatoes are done, add the salmon fillets to the baking sheet with the potatoes. Top each fillet with a slice of lemon.
Bake for another 10-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork. Serve the salmon and potatoes immediately.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Dill Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lemon, half juiced, half cut into wedges
instructions: Place the quartered potatoes in a pot and cover with cold water. Add a pinch of salt and bring to a boil. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until fork-tender.
While the potatoes are boiling, pat the salmon fillets dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the salmon fillets for about 3-4 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until cooked through and nicely browned. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Drain the cooked potatoes. In the same pot, gently toss the warm potatoes with the lemon juice, chopped dill, a little salt, and pepper.
Serve the pan-seared salmon alongside the lemon dill potatoes. Garnish with fresh dill and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Garlic Dill Potato Mash with Salmon
instructions: Place the cubed potatoes in a pot, cover with cold water, add a pinch of salt, and bring to a boil. Cook for about 15-20 minutes, until tender when pierced with a fork.

While the potatoes cook, pat the salmon fillets dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through.

Once the potatoes are tender, drain them well. In the same pot, mash the potatoes with the minced garlic, chopped dill, lemon juice, and the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ensure the mashed potatoes are smooth and well combined. If they seem too dry, you can add a tiny splash of water or more lemon juice.
Serve the pan-seared salmon over a generous portion of the garlic dill potato mash. Garnish with a little extra dill if you like.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions until al dente, which means it's cooked through but still has a slight bite. Drain the pasta, reserving about half a cup of the cooking water, and set aside.

While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes until they are softened and lightly browned.

Pour in the coconut cream and add the nutritional yeast to the skillet. Stir everything together and let it simmer gently for about 2-3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Season with salt and black pepper to your taste.

Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the mushroom sauce. Toss everything together to coat the pasta evenly. If the sauce seems too thick, add a little of the reserved pasta water, a tablespoon at a time, until it reaches your desired consistency.
Serve the pasta immediately, ensuring each portion is generously coated in the creamy mushroom sauce.

recipes.name: Garlicky Mushroom Sauté with Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until it is tender but still slightly firm. Drain the pasta, reserving about 1/4 cup of the cooking water, and set it aside.

While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until it smells nice. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and have released their liquid.
Sprinkle the nutritional yeast over the mushrooms and stir well to combine. Season generously with salt and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan with the mushrooms. Toss everything together to coat the pasta. If it seems a bit dry, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to create a light sauce.
Serve the garlicky mushroom pasta immediately.

recipes.name: Dairy-Free Garlic Mushroom Sauté
ingredients: 1 tbsp nutritional yeast (optional, for a cheesy flavor)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-45 seconds until it becomes fragrant, making sure it doesn't burn.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and have released their moisture.
If using, stir in the nutritional yeast. Season the mushrooms with salt and black pepper to your liking.
Cook for another minute, stirring to combine all the flavors.
Serve the sautéed mushrooms warm.

recipes.name: Dairy-Free Potato and Chive Mash
ingredients: 1/4 cup oat milk or soy milk (instead of milk)
instructions: Boil the potatoes in a pot of salted water until they are very tender when you poke them with a fork, about 15-20 minutes.
Drain the potatoes well and return them to the warm pot. Add the olive oil and oat milk (or soy milk) and mash them until smooth. You can use a potato masher or a fork.
Stir in the chopped chives and season with salt and pepper to your liking. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Crispy Dairy-Free Potato Wedges
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a bowl, toss the potato wedges with olive oil, salt, pepper, rosemary, and thyme until they are evenly coated. This helps them get crispy.
Spread the seasoned potato wedges in a single layer on a baking sheet. Make sure they aren't touching too much so they can get nice and brown.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until they are tender on the inside and golden brown and crispy on the outside. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Fried Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, peeled and cut into thin strips (like french fries)
instructions: Wash the potato strips well under cold water to remove excess starch, then dry them thoroughly with a clean towel. This helps them get crispier.
Place the potato strips in a saucepan with enough water to cover them and bring to a boil. Simmer for about 10-15 minutes until they are slightly tender but not mushy.
Drain the potatoes very well and make sure they are as dry as possible. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat.
Carefully add the parboiled potato strips to the hot oil. Fry for about 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy. Season with salt before serving.

recipes.name: Simple Chicken Curry with Rice
ingredients: 1 large chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions. While the rice cooks, heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and slightly golden, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces to the pan and cook until browned on all sides. Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the water, add salt and pepper, and bring to a simmer. Cover the pan and let it cook for about 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork. Serve the chicken curry over the fluffy rice.

recipes.name: Quick Chicken and Onion Rice
ingredients: 1 large chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot or saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until it's soft and smells sweet, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook until they are no longer pink on the outside. Stir in the curry powder and cook for another minute until it smells fragrant.
Add the uncooked rice and stir it around to coat it with the oil and spices. Pour in the water and add salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil.

Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover the pot tightly, and let it simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and all the water has been absorbed. Let it rest for 5 minutes off the heat before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice with Onion
ingredients: 1 large chicken breast, sliced into thin strips
½ yellow onion, chopped into strips
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and cook until they are browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the pan. Add the chopped onion and stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the cooked rice and curry powder to the pan. Stir everything together well, breaking up any clumps of rice. Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is heated through.
Return the cooked chicken to the pan. Stir in salt and pepper to taste. Cook for another 1-2 minutes to heat the chicken through. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Breakfast Porridge
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the oats and oat milk (or water). Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes until the oats are tender and the mixture has thickened.
Stir in the mashed banana and honey until everything is well combined and heated through. This should take another 1-2 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 tsp cinnamon (optional, if you have it)
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a bowl, mash the banana until it's smooth.
Add the oats, honey, and cinnamon (if using) to the mashed banana. Mix everything together until it forms a sticky dough.
Drop rounded spoonfuls of the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, about 2 inches apart. Flatten them slightly with the back of the spoon.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden. Let them cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Sweet Banana Mash
instructions: Peel the bananas and place them in a bowl. Mash them with a fork until they are mostly smooth, with a few small lumps remaining.
Stir in the honey until it is fully combined with the mashed banana. You can serve this immediately as a simple snack or dessert.

recipes.name: Cheesy Spinach and Bacon Scramble
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded cheese (like cheddar or mozzarella)
instructions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove the bacon with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the bacon fat in the pan.
Add the spinach to the skillet with the bacon fat and cook until wilted, about 1-2 minutes. Remove the spinach and set aside with the bacon.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Pour the eggs into the same skillet (add a little butter or oil if needed).
Cook the eggs, stirring gently, until they are almost set but still a little wet. This should take about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the cooked bacon and spinach, and sprinkle the cheese over the top.
Continue to cook for another minute, stirring gently, until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Bacon and Spinach Egg Cups
ingredients: Cooking spray or oil for muffin tin
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease a muffin tin with cooking spray or oil to prevent sticking.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper until well combined. This should take about 30 seconds.
Stir in the chopped spinach, crumbled bacon, and half of the shredded cheese into the egg mixture.
Pour the egg mixture evenly into the prepared muffin cups, filling each about two-thirds full.
Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top of each egg cup.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the tops are lightly golden. Let them cool slightly before removing from the muffin tin.

recipes.name: Cheesy Bacon and Spinach Frittata
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until it wilts down, which usually takes about 2-3 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and pepper until well combined. This should take about 30 seconds.
Pour the whisked eggs over the spinach in the skillet. Sprinkle the cooked bacon and most of the cheese over the eggs.
Cook on the stovetop without stirring for about 4-5 minutes, until the edges of the frittata start to set.

Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the frittata is puffed up and cooked through. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top during the last few minutes of baking. Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

recipes.name: Garlic Chicken Thighs with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel and season generously with salt and pepper. In a small bowl, mix the minced garlic with 1 tablespoon of olive oil.

Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs and cook for about 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the broccoli florets to the same skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are tender-crisp. Add the garlic oil mixture to the broccoli and toss to coat.
Return the chicken thighs to the skillet with the broccoli. Cover and cook for another 2-3 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Keto Garlic Chicken Thighs with Roasted Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the broccoli florets with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, half of the minced garlic, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Spread them in a single layer.
In a small bowl, mix the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil with the rest of the minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Rub this mixture all over the chicken thighs.
Place the seasoned chicken thighs on the same baking sheet as the broccoli, nestled among the florets.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through (internal temperature of 165°F or 74°C) and the broccoli is tender and slightly browned at the edges. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Chicken Thighs with Broccoli
ingredients: 1 head of broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper on both sides. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs and cook for about 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-60 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. This creates a simple garlic butter sauce.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the garlic butter. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the broccoli is tender-crisp. Season the broccoli with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Return the chicken thighs to the skillet and toss them in the garlic butter sauce with the broccoli. Cook for another minute to heat through. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Butter-Seared Salmon with Asparagus and Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Steam or boil the cauliflower florets until very tender, about 10-15 minutes. Drain well and mash with 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, and pepper until smooth and creamy. Set aside and keep warm.

Trim the tough ends off the asparagus. In a large skillet, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat. Add the asparagus and sauté for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp, seasoning with salt and pepper.

Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and pepper. Add the salmon to the same skillet (add a little more butter if needed) and sear for 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through and flaky. Adjust heat as needed to prevent burning the butter.
Serve the seared salmon alongside the sautéed asparagus and the cauliflower mash.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Trim the tough ends from the asparagus spears. Toss the asparagus with 1 teaspoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.

Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels. Season generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add the remaining olive oil to a large oven-safe skillet and heat over medium-high heat until shimmering.

Carefully place the salmon fillets in the hot skillet, skin-side down if they have skin. Sear for about 3-4 minutes until the skin is crispy and golden brown. Flip the salmon and sear the other side for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet with the salmon to the preheated oven. Place the baking sheet with the asparagus alongside the salmon.
Roast everything for 8-10 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork, and the asparagus is tender-crisp. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Butter-Poached Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Trim the tough ends off the asparagus. In a skillet large enough to hold the salmon and asparagus in a single layer, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium-low heat.
Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook gently for about 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp. Season with salt and pepper. Remove the asparagus from the skillet and set aside, keeping it warm.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet. Season the salmon fillets on both sides with salt and pepper.

Place the salmon fillets into the melted butter. Cook gently over low heat for about 4-6 minutes per side, depending on thickness, basting the salmon with the butter as it cooks. The salmon is done when it flakes easily with a fork.
Serve the butter-poached salmon with the sautéed asparagus.

recipes.name: Keto Beef Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain any excess fat from the skillet. Stir in the chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Spoon the seasoned ground beef into the individual lettuce leaves.
Top each lettuce wrap with shredded cheese and diced tomato before serving.

recipes.name: Cheesy Ground Beef Skillet
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Drain off any excess grease. Stir in the garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and sprinkle the shredded cheese over the ground beef. Cover the skillet and let it cook until the cheese is melted and gooey, about 3-5 minutes.
Serve the cheesy ground beef mixture over a bed of chopped lettuce, topped with diced tomatoes.

recipes.name: Keto Ground Beef and Tomato Scramble
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Drain off excess fat.
Add the diced tomato to the skillet with the ground beef and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour the whisked eggs into the skillet over the beef and tomato mixture. Stir gently as the eggs cook until they are set but still moist.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the scramble and let it melt for about a minute before serving.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Sautéed Apples and Onions
instructions: Pat the pork chops dry with a paper towel and season them generously with salt and pepper. This helps create a nice crust when cooking.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Carefully place the seasoned pork chops in the hot skillet and sear for about 4-5 minutes per side, until nicely browned.

Reduce the heat to medium-low, add the sliced apples and onions to the skillet with the pork chops. Cook for another 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples are tender and slightly caramelized, and the onions are soft and sweet. You can cover the pan for a few minutes to help soften them faster.
Make sure the pork chops are cooked through; they should reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C). Spoon the cooked apples and onions over the pork chops before serving.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Mash with Sautéed Onion
ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Place the cauliflower florets in a pot and cover them with water. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook for about 10-12 minutes, or until the cauliflower is very tender when poked with a fork.

While the cauliflower cooks, heat the olive oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook slowly, stirring often, for about 10-15 minutes until it is soft, sweet, and lightly browned.

Drain the cooked cauliflower very well, returning it to the pot. Mash the cauliflower with a fork or a potato masher until it's mostly smooth. You can also use an immersion blender for a smoother texture, but be careful not to over-process.
Season the mashed cauliflower with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir in half of the sautéed onions. Serve the cauliflower mash topped with the remaining sautéed onions.

recipes.name: Simple Pork and Apple Slices
instructions: Season the pork chops on both sides with salt and pepper. Pat them dry to help them brown nicely.

Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it is hot and shimmering. Place the pork chops in the skillet and cook for about 4-5 minutes per side, until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the pork chops from the skillet and set them aside on a plate. Tent them loosely with foil to keep them warm.

Add the sliced apples to the same skillet. Cook for about 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples are slightly softened but still hold their shape. You can add a tiny splash of water if the pan is too dry.
Serve the pork chops immediately with the warm apple slices on the side.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Zucchini Noodles with Lemon Garlic Sauce
instructions: Prepare the zucchini noodles by spiralizing or julienning them. Set aside. Peel and devein the shrimp, and mince the garlic. Juice the lemon.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the zucchini noodles to the skillet with the shrimp. Toss gently and cook for 3-4 minutes, just until the noodles are slightly tender but still have a bite.
Squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the shrimp and zucchini noodles. Toss everything together to coat evenly.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp and Zucchini Skillet
ingredients: 1 lemon, half juiced, half cut into wedges for serving
instructions: Prepare your ingredients: peel and devein the shrimp, slice the zucchini, mince the garlic, and juice half of the lemon.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until it smells aromatic.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for about 2-3 minutes per side, until they turn pink and are cooked through. Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced zucchini to the same skillet. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini is tender-crisp.
Return the cooked shrimp to the skillet. Add the fresh lemon juice and toss everything together well.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking. Serve the shrimp and zucchini mixture hot, with lemon wedges on the side.

recipes.name: Garlic Lemon Zucchini Ribbons
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, peeled into ribbons or julienned
instructions: Use a vegetable peeler or julienne tool to create long, thin ribbons or strands from the zucchini. Mince the garlic and juice half a lemon.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30-45 seconds until it's fragrant, making sure it doesn't brown.
Add the zucchini ribbons to the skillet. Toss them gently with the garlic and oil.
Cook for just 3-5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the zucchini is tender but still slightly crisp. You want it to wilt but not become mushy.
Remove the skillet from the heat. Stir in the fresh lemon juice.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately as a light side dish.

recipes.name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps with Tomato and Mayo
ingredients: 200 g turkey, thinly sliced or shredded
4 large lettuce leaves (like romaine or iceberg)
instructions: Prepare the turkey by ensuring it's in bite-sized pieces. If using deli turkey, you can tear it into smaller strips. Season the turkey lightly with salt and pepper. If your turkey is cooked, you can skip any further cooking.
Wash and dry the lettuce leaves thoroughly; these will be your wraps. Dice one tomato and place it in a small bowl. Add the mayonnaise to the diced tomato and stir gently to combine.
Lay out the lettuce leaves on a clean surface. Spoon the tomato-mayonnaise mixture evenly into each lettuce leaf. Top with the prepared turkey.
Carefully fold or roll the lettuce leaves to enclose the filling. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Turkey and Tomato Egg Scramble
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil or butter (common pantry staple)
instructions: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with salt and pepper until well combined. Stir in the mayonnaise until smooth. This will make the eggs extra creamy.
Heat the olive oil or butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until it shimmers. Add the diced turkey and cook for about 2-3 minutes until it's warmed through and slightly browned.
Pour the whisked egg mixture over the turkey in the skillet. Let it cook undisturbed for about 1 minute until the edges start to set.

Gently push the cooked egg from the edges towards the center with a spatula, allowing the uncooked egg to flow underneath. Continue this process until the eggs are mostly cooked but still slightly moist.
Stir in the diced tomato and cook for another minute, just until the tomatoes are slightly softened and the eggs are cooked to your liking. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Deconstructed Turkey Salad
ingredients: 200 g turkey, cooked and sliced or diced
instructions: Prepare the turkey by ensuring it's in bite-sized pieces. If using deli turkey, you can tear it into smaller strips. Season the turkey lightly with salt and pepper.
Wash and dry the lettuce leaves. These will serve as the base of your salad. Dice one tomato and place it in a small bowl.
Add the mayonnaise to the diced tomato. Stir gently to combine and create a simple dressing. Season this dressing with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Arrange the lettuce leaves on two plates. Top the lettuce with the prepared turkey and then spoon the tomato-mayonnaise mixture over the turkey.
Serve immediately as a light and refreshing meal.

recipes.name: Chicken and Sweet Potato Skillet
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 large sweet potato, peeled and diced
instructions: In a bowl, toss the chicken pieces and diced sweet potato with olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder until everything is well coated. This helps the seasonings stick and ensures even flavor.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken and sweet potato to the hot skillet, spreading them out in a single layer. Cook for about 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the sweet potatoes are tender and slightly browned. This method ensures everything cooks evenly and develops a nice sear.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato and Chicken Hash
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 large sweet potato, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss the cubed chicken breast and sweet potato with olive oil, salt, pepper, and rosemary until evenly coated. This ensures all the pieces get flavored.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and sweet potato mixture to the skillet in a single layer. Cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the sweet potatoes are tender and browned. Make sure to stir so they don't stick and cook evenly.

recipes.name: Paleo Chicken and Sweet Potato Mash
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and cubed
instructions: Place the cubed sweet potato in a saucepan with the water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for about 15-20 minutes, or until very tender when poked with a fork. This makes it easy to mash.

While the sweet potato is cooking, season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken breasts for about 6-8 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove chicken from skillet and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.

Once the sweet potato is tender, drain any excess water. Mash the sweet potato with a fork or potato masher until smooth. You can add a tiny bit more water if needed to reach your desired consistency. Serve the sliced chicken alongside the sweet potato mash.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-fry with Cashew Nuts
instructions: In a bowl, toss the thinly sliced beef with 1 tablespoon of coconut aminos. Let it marinate for about 10 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the marinated beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the broccoli florets to the same skillet, adding a tablespoon of water if needed to help them steam. Cook for 3-5 minutes until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green.
If using, add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return the browned beef to the skillet with the broccoli. Pour in the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut aminos and stir everything together to coat.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes until the beef is heated through and the sauce has slightly thickened.
Stir in the cashews and toss to combine. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Paleo Beef and Broccoli Bowl
ingredients: 200 g beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tbsp coconut aminos (instead of soy sauce)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the broccoli florets to the skillet with the beef. Pour in the coconut aminos and stir well to coat everything.
Cover the skillet and let the broccoli steam and cook for about 5-7 minutes, or until it is tender-crisp and bright green.
Uncover and stir everything together. Cook for another 1-2 minutes to allow the flavors to meld and any excess liquid to evaporate.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Steamed Broccoli with Beef Strips
ingredients: 200 g beef, cut into thin strips
1 tbsp coconut aminos (instead of soy sauce)
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the beef strips with 1/2 tablespoon of coconut aminos, salt, and pepper. Let it sit for a few minutes.
Place the broccoli florets in a steamer basket over a pot of simmering water. Cover and steam for 5-7 minutes, until the broccoli is tender-crisp and bright green.
While the broccoli steams, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of coconut aminos to the skillet with the beef and stir to coat. Cook for another minute until the sauce is slightly reduced.
Once the broccoli is ready, carefully remove it from the steamer. Arrange the steamed broccoli on plates.
Top the broccoli with the cooked beef strips. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Spinach Scramble
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and slightly browned.
Add the spinach to the pan with the mushrooms and cook for another 1-2 minutes until it wilts down. Season with salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs until they are well combined. Pour the whisked eggs into the pan with the mushrooms and spinach.
Gently stir and fold the eggs as they cook, allowing them to scramble. Cook for about 3-5 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through to your liking. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Paleo Mushroom Steaks with Spinach
instructions: Gently clean the portobello mushrooms and remove the stems. Brush both sides of the mushroom caps with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat a grill pan or a large skillet over medium-high heat. Place the mushroom caps, gill-side down, and cook for about 5-7 minutes until nicely browned and slightly softened.

Flip the mushrooms and cook for another 5-7 minutes until tender. While the mushrooms are cooking, in a separate pan, briefly sauté the spinach with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper until just wilted.
Serve the cooked mushroom caps topped with the sautéed spinach. This makes for a satisfying and simple main dish.

recipes.name: Simple Sautéed Mushrooms and Spinach
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 7-10 minutes until they are tender and have released their moisture.
Add the spinach to the skillet with the mushrooms. Continue to cook, stirring, for about 1-2 minutes until the spinach is wilted.
Season the mushroom and spinach mixture with salt and pepper to your taste. Stir everything together to combine.
Serve hot as a delicious and healthy side dish.

recipes.name: Spicy Peanut Tofu Noodles
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (optional, for spice)
instructions: Cook the gluten-free noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

While the noodles cook, prepare the tofu. Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown and slightly crispy on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.

In a small bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, sugar (if using), and red pepper flakes (if using). If the sauce is too thick, add a tablespoon or two of warm water until it reaches a smooth, pourable consistency.
Add the cooked noodles and the browned tofu to the skillet. Pour the peanut sauce over the noodles and tofu. Toss gently to coat everything evenly.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is heated through and clings to the noodles and tofu. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Lime Peanut Tofu Salad
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and sliced into thin triangles
1 tsp sesame oil (optional, if you have it)
Mixed greens or other salad vegetables (e.g., shredded carrots, cucumber, bell peppers - use what you have)
instructions: Press the tofu to remove as much water as possible, then slice it into thin triangles. In a shallow dish, whisk together the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, sesame oil (if using), and water to create a marinade.
Place the tofu slices in the marinade, ensuring they are coated. Let them marinate for at least 10-15 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
While the tofu marinates, prepare your salad base with your chosen greens and vegetables. Arrange them on two plates.
Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the tofu from the marinade (reserve the marinade) and place the slices in the hot skillet.
Cook the tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and slightly crispy. Remove from skillet.
Drizzle the reserved marinade over the salad greens and vegetables. Top the salad with the pan-fried tofu slices. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Simple Tofu with Lime and Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess water, then cut it into bite-sized cubes. In a small bowl, whisk together the peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and sugar (if using) to create the sauce. Add a tablespoon of water if the sauce is too thick.

Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy on most sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low. Pour the prepared peanut-lime sauce over the tofu in the skillet. Stir gently to coat all the tofu pieces.
Cook for another 1-2 minutes, allowing the sauce to warm through and thicken slightly, coating the tofu. If the sauce becomes too thick, add another splash of water. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Mushroom Pasta (Dairy-Free)
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to package directions in salted boiling water. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.

Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet with the chicken and cook until they are softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Pour in the coconut cream and stir to combine. Let it simmer gently for a few minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.

Season the sauce with salt and pepper to your liking. Drain the cooked pasta and add it directly to the skillet with the chicken and mushroom sauce. Toss everything together gently to coat the pasta evenly. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Garlic Mushroom Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.

Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the same skillet. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and browned, about 5-7 minutes.

Return the cooked chicken to the skillet with the mushrooms and garlic. Stir everything together and cook for another 1-2 minutes to heat the chicken through. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Mushroom and Chicken Stuffed Eggplant (Dairy-Free)
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving about a 1/4-inch border. Coarsely chop the scooped-out eggplant flesh and set aside. Rub the inside of the eggplant shells with a little olive oil and place them on a baking sheet.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped chicken and cook until browned. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

Add the chopped mushrooms and the reserved chopped eggplant flesh to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 8-10 minutes. Season the mixture with salt and pepper.

Spoon the chicken and mushroom filling evenly into the prepared eggplant shells. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and the filling is heated through. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Quick Vegan Pesto Pasta with Cherry Tomatoes and Pine Nuts
ingredients: 2 tbsp pine nuts, plus extra for garnish
1 tbsp nutritional yeast (optional, for cheesy flavor)
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of the pasta water before draining.

While the pasta cooks, make the vegan pesto. In a food processor or blender, combine the basil leaves, 2 tablespoons of pine nuts, olive oil, garlic, and nutritional yeast (if using). Blend until mostly smooth, adding a tablespoon of the reserved pasta water if needed to reach a saucy consistency.
In a large bowl, toss the drained pasta with the vegan pesto. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with extra pine nuts and a pinch of salt and pepper if desired.

recipes.name: Garlic Cherry Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of the pasta water before draining.

While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and cook for about 1-2 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden, being careful not to burn it.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes to the skillet with the garlic and olive oil. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes soften and start to burst.
Drain the pasta and add it directly to the skillet with the tomatoes and garlic. Toss everything together, adding a splash of the reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too dry.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Toasted Pine Nut Pasta with Blistered Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of the pasta water before draining.

While the pasta cooks, place the pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium-low heat. Toast them for 2-4 minutes, shaking the pan often, until they are lightly golden and fragrant. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for about 5-7 minutes, until they soften and start to blister.

Drain the pasta and add it to the skillet with the blistered tomatoes. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and toss to combine. Add a splash of the reserved pasta water if needed to create a light sauce.
Stir in most of the toasted pine nuts. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pasta immediately, garnished with the remaining toasted pine nuts.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Romaine Salad with Lemon-Mustard Dressing
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the romaine lettuce, chickpeas, and croutons. Make sure the lettuce is well-drained and dry to prevent a watery salad.
