In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper until well combined. This makes a simple yet flavorful dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to coat everything evenly. Serve immediately for the best texture.

recipes.name: Crispy Chickpea and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Prepare the romaine lettuce by washing and tearing it into bite-sized pieces. Ensure it is dry before adding other ingredients.
In a large bowl, combine the prepared romaine lettuce with the rinsed and drained chickpeas and the croutons. The croutons will add a nice crunch.
Make a simple dressing by whisking together olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently until all ingredients are lightly coated. Serve right away.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea and Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Wash and chop the romaine lettuce, then place it in a large salad bowl. Make sure the lettuce is dry.
Add the rinsed and drained chickpeas and the croutons to the bowl with the lettuce. These will provide texture and substance to the salad.
In a separate small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper to create a simple dressing. This dressing will add a tangy flavor.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss gently to combine. Serve immediately to enjoy the crispness of the lettuce and croutons.

recipes.name: Simple Chicken and Vegetable Stew
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 gluten-free stock cube (or vegetable stock cube)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and add the chicken pieces. Cook until they are lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot. Stir them around with the chicken for about 2 minutes.
Pour in 2 cups of water and add the gluten-free stock cube. Stir to dissolve the cube.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for about 20 minutes, or until the potatoes and carrots are tender when pierced with a fork.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking. Stir everything together and serve hot.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Chicken with Roasted Potatoes and Carrots
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, seasoned with salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the potato wedges and carrot chunks with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Spread them out in a single layer.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until they are tender and slightly browned.
While the vegetables are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the seasoned chicken breasts to the hot skillet. Cook for about 6-8 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and has a nice golden-brown crust.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing. Serve the pan-fried chicken alongside the roasted potatoes and carrots.

recipes.name: Dutch-Inspired Mashed Potatoes and Carrots
instructions: Place the quartered potatoes in a pot and cover them with water. Add a pinch of salt and bring to a boil, then cook until they are very tender when poked with a fork, about 15-20 minutes.
In a separate pot, cover the chopped carrots with water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook until the carrots are tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Drain the cooked potatoes and carrots well. Return them to their separate pots or put them into a large bowl.
Mash the potatoes until smooth. Mash the carrots separately or together with the potatoes, depending on your preference. Add a little of the cooking water if needed to reach your desired consistency.
Stir in the olive oil if using, and season generously with salt and pepper. Mix everything together until well combined and serve warm.

recipes.name: Chocolate Covered Strawberries with Whipped Cream
instructions: Gently wash and pat dry the strawberries. Make sure they are completely dry, as water can make the chocolate seize.

Melt the dark chocolate. You can do this by placing it in a heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water (making sure the bottom of the bowl doesn't touch the water), or by carefully microwaving it in short bursts, stirring in between.
Once the chocolate is smooth and melted, dip each strawberry into the chocolate, coating about two-thirds of the way up. Let any excess chocolate drip off.

Place the chocolate-covered strawberries on a plate or baking sheet lined with parchment paper. You can let them set at room temperature or pop them in the fridge for about 10-15 minutes to speed up the process.
While the strawberries are setting, whip the cream. Pour the cold cream into a bowl. If you like it sweeter, add the sugar now. Beat with a whisk or electric mixer until soft peaks form.
Serve the chocolate-covered strawberries with a generous spoonful of the freshly whipped cream.

recipes.name: Strawberry Chocolate Fool
instructions: Lightly mash about half of the chopped strawberries with a fork to release their juices. Leave the other half in small chunks for texture.
Whip the cold cream in a bowl until it forms soft peaks. If you prefer a sweeter dessert, add the sugar while whipping.
Gently fold the mashed and chunky strawberries into the whipped cream. Try not to overmix, you want to keep some airiness.
Finely grate or chop the dark chocolate. Reserve about half for garnish.
Gently fold most of the grated chocolate into the strawberry and cream mixture.
Spoon the mixture into two serving glasses or bowls. Top with the remaining grated chocolate and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Chocolate Strawberry Parfait
instructions: Prepare the whipped cream by whipping the cold cream with the sugar (if using) until soft peaks form. Set aside.
Melt the dark chocolate. You can do this in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, or over a double boiler. Let it cool slightly so it's not too hot to handle.
In two serving glasses or small bowls, start layering. Put a layer of sliced strawberries at the bottom.
Add a layer of the whipped cream on top of the strawberries.
Drizzle some of the slightly cooled melted dark chocolate over the cream layer.
Repeat the layers: strawberries, then cream, then a final drizzle of chocolate.
You can add a few small pieces of dark chocolate on top for decoration. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quick Chickpea and Spinach Curry
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
½ cup water or vegetable broth
Corn tortillas or cooked rice, for serving
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the curry paste and cook for about 1 minute until fragrant, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed chickpeas and water (or broth) to the pan. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until wilted. Season with salt to your liking.
Serve hot with corn tortillas or over cooked rice.

recipes.name: Spiced Chickpea and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the curry paste, olive oil, and lemon juice (if using) to make a dressing. Season with salt and pepper.
In a larger bowl, combine the rinsed chickpeas and fresh spinach.
Pour the dressing over the chickpea and spinach mixture and toss gently to coat everything evenly. Let it sit for about 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve as a light salad or a side dish.

recipes.name: Curried Chickpea and Spinach Skillet
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained
½ cup water or vegetable broth
Corn tortillas or cooked rice, for serving
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the curry paste and cook for about 1 minute until it smells aromatic, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed chickpeas and water (or broth) to the skillet. Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the fresh spinach and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until it wilts down. Season with salt to your preference.
Serve the chickpea and spinach mixture hot, perhaps with corn tortillas or over cooked rice.

recipes.name: Vegan Kimchi Tofu Stir-fry with Rice
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 cup vegan kimchi, chopped (ensure no fish sauce)
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped vegan kimchi to the pan with the tofu. Stir and cook for about 3-5 minutes, allowing the kimchi to heat through and its flavors to meld with the tofu.
Stir in most of the chopped spring onions, reserving some for garnish. Cook for another minute until they are slightly softened.
Season with salt and pepper to your liking. Be mindful that kimchi can be salty already.
Serve the tofu and kimchi mixture hot over the cooked rice. Garnish with the remaining chopped spring onions.

recipes.name: Simple Steamed Rice with Tofu and Spring Onion
ingredients: 2 cups water (or as per rice package instructions)
200 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then cook it according to package directions, usually by simmering in water until tender and the water is absorbed.
While the rice cooks, heat the vegetable oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is golden brown and slightly crispy on all sides, about 7-10 minutes.
Add about half of the chopped spring onions to the pan with the tofu during the last minute of cooking, stirring gently.
Season the tofu and spring onion mixture with salt and pepper.

Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and divide it between two bowls. Top the rice with the pan-fried tofu and spring onion mixture. Sprinkle the remaining fresh spring onions over the top before serving.

recipes.name: Savory Tofu and Spring Onion Rice Bowl
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 tbsp soy sauce (or tamari for gluten-free)
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the cubed tofu and cook until it's golden brown and a little crispy on all sides, which should take about 7-10 minutes.
Once the tofu is browned, add most of the sliced spring onions to the pan. Stir for about 1 minute until they become fragrant and slightly softened.
Drizzle the soy sauce and sesame oil (if using) over the tofu and spring onions. Toss everything together to coat evenly and cook for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remember soy sauce is salty, so taste before adding too much salt.
Serve the tofu and spring onion mixture over the cooked rice. Garnish with the remaining fresh spring onions.
